sa: प्रजोच्छेदो मम कृतो यस्माद् युष्माभिरद्य वै। तस्मात् प्रजा वः स्वगमा: सर्वेषां न भविष्यति॥
en: Indeed, since you have opposed the birth of an offspring from me, therefore, you shall have no offspring of your own When this curse was imprecated.

sa: एते तु नियमाः सर्वे कर्तव्या: शरदो दश। द्वे चान्ये भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रवृत्तिमनुवर्तता॥
en: These rules which I speak of, O chief of Bharata's race, should be observed for twelve years. Be disposed to do it.

sa: अथोपपत्त्या शकटं पद्मवज्रं च भारत। उशना वेद यच्छास्त्रं तत्रेतद् विहितं विभो॥
en: According to the science known to Ushanas, arrays called Shakata, Padma, and Vajra, should be formed, O Bharata, for fighting the enemy.

sa: ततो विगतसंत्रासा वयमप्यरिकशन। यच्छुतं यच्च दृष्टं नस्तत् प्रवक्ष्यामहे हरे॥
en: Our fears being removed, we shall then, O Hari, recite to you what we have heard and seen.

sa: स राजा धर्मराज राजन् दीक्षितो विबभौ तदा। हेममाली रुक्मकण्ठः प्रदीप्त इव पावकः॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira the just, O king, after the initiation, adorned with a garland of gold around his neck, shone like a burning fire.

sa: क्षत्रियैः सह योऽश्नीयाद् ब्राह्मणोऽप्येकभोजने। आप्लुत: सह वासोभिस्तेन मुच्येत पाप्मना॥
en: If a Brahmana takes his food with Kshatriyas, he should perform expiation by bathing with his clothes on.

sa: संजीव्य कालमिष्टं च सशरीरो दिवं गतः। बभूव तस्य पुत्रस्तु ययातिरिव धर्मवित्॥ अविक्षिन्नाम शत्रुजित् स वशे कृतवान् महीम्। विक्रमेण गुणैश्चैव पितेवासीत् स पार्थिवः॥
en: And having lives as long as he desired, he ascended the celestial region in his bodily form. And his named Avikshitconqueror of enemies-righteous like Yayati, brought all the Earth under his sway. And both in merit and power the king resembled his father. son

sa: वाचस्पतिं चन्द्रमसमपः पृथ्वी सरस्वतीम्। सततं ये नमस्यन्ति तान् नमस्याम्यहं विभो॥ तपोधनान् वेदविदो नित्यं वेदपरायणान्। महार्हान् वृष्णिशार्दूल सदा सम्पूजयाम्यहम्।।८
en: O foremost of Vrishni's race, I always adore those Brahmanas who are are endued with penances, who are conversant with the Vedas who are always given to Vedic study, and who are possessed of great worth.

sa: भगदेवानुयातानां सर्वासा वामलोचना। माहेश्वरी महादेवी प्रोच्यते पार्वती हि सा॥
en: Among those that are followed by persons full of desire is the great goddess Mahesvari having beautiful eyes.

sa: शून्येयं च मही कृत्स्ना न मे प्रीतिकरी शुभे। बान्धवा नः परिक्षीणा बलं नो न यथा पुरा।॥
en: The entire Earth is empty now. O auspicious lady, she does not please me any longer! Our kinsmen have been reduced in number. Our strength is no longer what it was before.

sa: भवन्तोऽस्य च वीरस्य व्यासभूताः कृता मया। यदेव तैः कृतं किंचिद् व्यलीकं वः सुतैर्मम॥ यदन्येन मदीयेन तदनुज्ञातुमर्हथ।
en: You should all forget and forgive whatever injury has been done to you by those sons of mine who are no longer alive, or, indeed, by any one else belonging to me.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं नास्ति पावनं दिवि चेह च। उपवासैस्तथा तुल्यं तपःकर्म न विद्यते॥
en: There is nothing, more sacred, in Heaven or Earth, than Brahmanas. Similarly there is no penance that is superior to the observance of fasts.

sa: संवर्त उवाच सत्यमेतद् भवानाह स मां जानाति सत्रिणम्। कथयस्व तदेतन्मे क्व न सम्प्रति नारदः॥
en: Samvarta said You have told this to me truly, he (Narada) knows me to be a performer of sacrifices, now tell me where is Narada living at present.

sa: ते कोशानग्रतः कृत्वा विविशेः स्वपुरं तदा॥ पाण्डवाः प्रीतमनसः सामात्याः ससुहणाः।
en: With rejoicing hearts, the Pandavas, accompanied by their officers and friends, entered the capital, placing that treasure in their van.

sa: एष एव क्रमो हि स्यात् क्षत्रियाणां युधिष्ठिर। अष्टधा तु भवेत् कार्य क्षत्रियस्वं जनाधिप।॥
en: This should be the order, O Yudhishthira, of the wives of a Kshatriya. The property of a Kshatriya should, O king, be divided into eight shares.

sa: अन्यान् बाणान् समीक्षस्व यैस्त्वं मां सूदयिष्यसि। तच्छुत्वा स विचिन्त्याथ ततो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Do you look for other arrows with which to kill me! Hearing these words and thinking upon them, he said as follows.

sa: यदि स्म धर्मराज्ञा वा भीमसेनेन वा पुनः। त्वया वा पुण्डरीकाक्ष वाक्यमुक्तमिदं भवेत्॥ अजानतीमिपीकेयं जनित्री हन्त्विति प्रभो। अहमेव विनष्टा स्यां नैतदेवंगते भवेत्॥
en: If king Yudhishthira the just, or Bhimasena, or yourself, O lotus-eyes one, had, on that occasion, said, Let the blade of grass destroy the unconscious mother, O powerful one, then I would have been destroyed and this would not have taken place.

sa: सप्तगङ्गे त्रिगङ्गे च इन्द्रमार्गे च तर्पयन्॥ सुधां वै लभते भोक्तुं यो नरो जायते पुनः।
en: One who gives oblations of water to his departed manes at Saptaganga and Triganga and Indramarga, obtains ambrosia for food if one has still to go through rebirth.

sa: चपलाक्षस्य दायादे मृतेऽस्मिन् पुरुषर्षभ। विफला मे कृताः कृष्ण हृदि सर्वे मनोरथाः॥
en: O foremost of all beings at the death of this heir of Abhimanyu of restless eyes, all my hopes have been destroyed.

sa: अन्यान् बाणान् समीक्षस्व यैस्त्वं मां सूदयिष्यसि। तच्छुत्वा स विचिन्त्याथ ततो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Do you look for other arrows with which to destroy me! Hearing these words and thinking upon them, he said as follows.

sa: स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ गोषु नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितौ। गावो यज्ञस्य नेत्र्यो वै तथा यज्ञस्य ता मुखम्॥
en: The sacred Mantras, Svaha and Vashat, are always established upon kine. Kine are the chief conductresses of Sacrifices. They form the mouth of Sacrifice.

sa: सर्वे हि वयमेते च तवैव प्रसवः प्रभो। देवानां ब्राह्मणानां च त्वं हि कर्ता पितामह॥
en: All of us, as also all these, are your offspring, O you of great power. You, O Grandfather, are the Creator of both the celestials and the Brahmanas.

sa: अतः परं तु यद् गुह्यं तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति। सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोश्चापि सम्बन्धः केन हेतुना॥
en: You should declare to us, after this, what is (so) mysterious, and what is the cause of the connection between the Soul and Nature.

sa: भवितातः परं दुःखं किं तदन्यज्जनार्दन। अभिमन्योः सुतात् कृष्ण मृताज्जातादरिंदम॥
en: Bowing grief, O Janardana, can be greater than this, viz., that Abhimanyu's son should be born and dead?

sa: भीमसेनस्तु सक्रोधः प्रोवाचेदं वचस्तदा। वयं भीष्मस्य दास्यामः प्रेतकार्यं तु फाल्गुन॥ सोमदत्तस्य नृपते रिश्रवस एव च। बाह्रीकस्य च राजर्षेनॊणस्य च महात्मनः॥ अन्येषां चैव सर्वेषां कुन्ती कर्णाय दास्यति। श्राद्धानि पुरुषव्याघ्र मा प्रादात् कौरवो नृपः॥
en: Yielding to anger Bhimasena said these words :-O Phalguna, it is we that shall make gifts in the matter of Bhishma's obsequies, as also of king Somavatta and of Bhurishravas, of the royal sage Valhika, and of the great Drona, and of all others. Our mother Kunti shall make such obsequial offerings for Karna. O foremost of men, let not Dhritarashtra perform those Sharaddhas.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच दृष्ट्वा पुत्रांस्तथा पौत्रान् सानुबन्धान् जनाधिपः। धृतराष्ट्रः किमकरोद् राजा चैव युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Having seen his sons and grandsons with all their friends and followers, what, indeed, did that king, viz., Dhritarashtra, and king Yudhishthira also, do?

sa: उत्तरां च सुभद्रां च द्रौपदीं मां च माधव॥ धर्मपुत्रं च भीमं च फाल्गुनं नकुलं तथा। सहदेवं च दुर्धर्ष सर्वान् नस्त्रातुमर्हसि॥
en: That child, O son, has been born deed! Sec him, O foremost of men. You should, O Madhava, rescue Uttara and Subhadra and Draupadi and myself, and Dharma's son (Yudhishthira), and Bhima and Phalguna, and Nakula and the irresistible Sahadeva.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा धर्मराजस्तमर्जुनं प्रत्यपूजयत्। भीमसेनः कटाक्षेण वीक्षां चक्रे धनंजयम्॥
en: Having said these words, king Yudhishthira the just highly applauded Arjuna. Meanwhile Bhimasena began to cast angry looks at Dhananjaya.

sa: परितुष्टो भवाम्येवं मानुषाणां महात्मनाम्। तन्मां ये पूजयिष्यन्ति नास्ति तेषां पराभवः॥
en: Those great men who adore these, gratify me. Indeed, they who worship me in these forms never meet with dcfeat.

sa: तानागतान् समीक्ष्यैव धृतराष्ट्रो महीपतिः। प्रत्यगृह्वाद् यथान्यायं विदुरश्च महामनाः॥
en: Seeing those heroes come, king Dhritarashtra, as also the great Vidura, received them with due honours.

sa: तेषां प्रयास्यतां तत्र मङ्गलानि शुभान्यथा प्राहुः प्रहष्टमनसो द्विजण्या नागराश्च ते॥
en: While they thus started, the citizens, and many foremost of Brahmanas, with cheerful hearts, uttered auspicious blessings (on their heads).

sa: रत्नं च यन्मरुत्तेन निहितं वसुधातले। तदवाप कथं चेति तन्मे ब्रूहि द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Tell me, O foremost of twice-bom ones, how the king succeeded in obtaining the riches which Marutta had buried in the Earth!

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रभाते राजा स धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः। आहूय पाण्डवान् वीरान् वनवासे कृतक्षणः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having settled the hour of his departure for the forest, the royal son of Ambika, viz., Dhritarashtra, summoned those heroes, the Pandavas.

sa: स वध्यमानो वज्रेण तस्मिन्नमिततेजसा॥ विवेश सहसा शक्रं जग्राह विषयं ततः।
en: And thus smitten by the powerful Indra, he suddenly entered into his (Shakra's) body, and took away its essential attributes.

sa: ईदृशो मर्त्यधर्मोऽयं मा शुचो यदुनन्दिनि। पुत्रो हि तव दुर्घर्षः सम्प्राप्तः परमां गतिम्॥
en: O daughter of Yadu's race, mortal your son was. Do not grieve. Irresistible in battle, your son has, forsooth, attained to the highest end.

sa: भीष्म उवाच साम्ना प्रसाद्यते कश्चिद् दानेन च तथा परः। पुरुषप्रकृतिं ज्ञात्वा तयोरेकतरं भजेत्॥
en: Bhishma said Some become pleased by Conciliation, while others are pleased by Gifts. Every man, according to his own nature, likes the one or the other.

sa: यो मां प्रयतते हन्तुं ज्ञात्वा प्रहरणे बलम्। तस्य तस्मिन् प्रहरणे पुनः प्रादुर्भवाम्यहम्॥
en: (Kama says), No creature is able to destroy me without following the proper methods (viz., subjugation of all desires and practice of Yoga, etc.)

sa: एवमेवाप्यसंयुक्तः पुरुषः स्यान्न संशयः। द्रव्यमात्रमभूत् सत्त्वं पुरुषस्येति निश्चयः॥
en: Endued with knowledge, he is never tainted even if brought into contact with all the qualities.

sa: पितर ऊचुः अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। श्रुत्वा च तत् तथा कार्यं भवता द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Regarding it is cited this old, history. Having heard it, you should act according to it, O foremost of all twice-born persons.

sa: द्रौपदी च समासाद्य पर्यपृच्छत दुःखिता॥ आर्ये क्व दारकाः सर्वे द्रष्टुमिच्छामि तानहम्।
en: When she met Draupadi, she asked her in grief, O reverend lady, where are all our sons? I wish to see them.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु निहते वीरे सुभद्रेयं स्वसा मम॥ दुःखार्ताधो सुतं प्राप्य कुररीव ननाद ह।
en: After the fall of that hero, this my sister Subhadra, stricken with grief, bewailed aloud, when she saw Kunti, like a female as prey.

sa: अहोरात्रं विजानाति ऋतवश्चापि नित्यशः। पुरुषे पापकं कर्म शुभं वा शुभकर्मिणः॥
en: Day and Night and the Seasons, do know all the good and the bad deeds, that are in a man.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरः प्रादाद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथाविधि॥ कोटी: सहस्रं निष्काणां व्यासाय तु वसुंधराम्।
en: Then Yudhishthira gave away to the Brahmanas a thousand crores of golden nishkas, and to Vyasa he gave away the whole Earth.

sa: तमन्वधावत् संक्रुद्धो भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। हृदे द्वैपायने चापि सलिलस्थं ददर्श तम्॥
en: Then Bhimasena of great prowess, filled with anger, pursued him and discovered him within the waters of the Dvaipayana lake.

sa: आवर्तनानि चत्वारि साधयेच्चाप्यसौ नरः। दिवसे सप्तदशमे यः प्राप्ते प्राशते हविः॥ सदा द्वादशमासान् वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्। स्थानं वारुणमैन्द्रं च रौद्रं वाप्यधिगच्छति॥ मारुतौशनसे चैव ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति।
en: That man who having fasted for sixteen days, eats a little clarified butter on the seventeenth day, and acts thus for a whole year, pouring libations every day on his sacred fire, proceeds to the regions of Varuna and Indra and Rudra and the Maruts and Ushanas and Brahman himself.

sa: तेनैकने तु रक्षा वै विपुलेन कृता स्त्रियाः। नान्यः शक्तस्त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन् रक्षितुं नृप योषितम्।।२७
en: Only one man viz., Vipula, had succeeded in protecting woman. There is none else, o king, in the three worlds who can protect women.

sa: वासुकिप्रमुखानां च नागानां जनमेजय। सर्वे शशंस गुरवे यथावद् द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: That best of Brahmanas also told his preceptor everything about Vasuki and the other Nagas that had occurred.

sa: तस्माद् गुणांश्च सत्त्वं च परित्यज्येह धर्मवित्। क्षीणदोषो गुणातीतः क्षेत्रमं प्रविशत्यथ॥
en: Hence, who understands duties, renouncing qualities and the understanding, and having his destroyed, and transcending the qualities, enters the Kshetrajna.

sa: व्यास उवाच शुभेन कर्मणा यद्वै तिर्यग्योनौ न मुह्यसे। ममैव कीट तत् कर्म येन त्वं न प्रमुह्यसे॥
en: Vyasa said On account of a meritorious deed, Oworm, that you, though born in the intermediate order of being are not stupefied. For a deed of mine, Oworm you are not stupefied.

sa: तेषां कुन्ती महाराज पूजां चक्रे यथाविधि। ते चापि तुतुषुस्तस्यास्तापसाः परियर्चया॥
en: Kunti adored them with due rites, O king. All those ascetics were highly pleased with the adorations offered to them.

sa: न च मां च्यावयेद् राष्ट्रात् त्रिषु लोकेषु कश्चन। देवो वा मानुषो वापि तस्माज्ज्येष्ठो द्विजादहम्॥
en: Deity or man, there is none in the three worlds who can throw me off from the sovereignty I enjoy. Hence, I am certainly superior to the Brahmanas.

sa: श्रूयते न च मां हन्यादिति ह्यस्मादपक्रमे। श्वसतां च शृणोम्येनं गोपुत्राणां प्रतोद्यताम्॥
en: The sound is heard. Will it not kill me? I am flying away for this, I hear the sound of the bulls.

sa: कीट उवाच शकटस्यास्य महतो घोषं श्रुत्वा भयं मम। आगतं वै महाबुद्धे स्वन एष हि दारुणः॥
en: The worm said I am stricken with fear on hearing the rattle of that large car. O you of great intelligence, it makes a fearful roar. It is almost come.

sa: अवमानाः सुकष्टाश्च राजतः स्वजनात् तथा। शारीरा मानसा वापि वेदना भृशदारुणाः॥
en: I have received from king and relatives insults and excessive misery. I have suffered from serve mental and physical pain.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां सतामेष ब्राह्मो धर्मो युधिष्ठिर। आवाह्यमावहेदेवं यो दद्यादनुकूलतः॥
en: All righteous Brahmanas, O Yudhishthira, act thus. This is known as the Brahma marriage, O Yudhishthira.

sa: अन्यान् बाणान् समीक्षस्व यैस्त्वं मां सूदयिष्यसि। तच्छुत्वा स विचिन्त्याथ ततो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Do you look for other arrows with which to kill me! Hearing these words and thinking on them, he said as follows.

sa: पाण्डुः स्मरति ते नित्यं बलहन्तुः समीपगः। त्वां सदैव महाराज श्रेयसा स च योक्ष्यति॥
en: Living in the presence of the destroyer of Vala, Pandu thinks of you always. He will, O monarch, certainly assist you in the attainment of Prosperity.

sa: अतो राजर्षयः सर्वे मृगयां यान्ति भारत॥ न हि लिप्यन्ति पापेन न चैतत्पातकं विदुः।
en: Hence, O Bharata, even royal sages take to hunting. By such conduct they do not become stained with sin. Indeed the practice is not considered sinful.

sa: भीष्म उवाच सर्वाणि खलु तीर्थानि गुणवन्ति मनीषिणः। यत्तु तीर्थं च शौचं च तन्मे शृणु समाहितः॥
en: Bhishma said Forsooth, all Tirthas are possessed of merit. Listen, however, with attention to me as I tell you what the Tirtha, the cleanser, is of men gifted with wisdom.

sa: निविष्टं गोकुलं यत्र श्वासं मुञ्चति निर्भयम्। विराजयति तं देशं पापं चास्यापकर्षति॥
en: That country where, kine placed by their owners, breathe fearlessly, shines in beauty. The sins also of that country are all removed.

sa: स्वायम्भुवोऽत्रिः कौरव्य परमर्षिः प्रतापवान्। तस्य वंशे महाराज दत्तात्रेय इति स्मृतः॥
en: Form the SelfCreate Brahman sprang Atri, O you of Kuru's race. In Atri's family was born a Muni named Dattatreya.

sa: अहंकारात् परा बुद्धिर्बुद्धेरात्मा ततः परः। तस्मात् तु परमव्यक्तमव्यक्तात् पुरुषः परः॥
en: Above egoism is understanding. Above understanding is the soul. Above the soul is the Unmanifest. Above the Unmanifest is Purusha.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अविप्रणाशः सर्वेषां कर्मणामिति निश्चयः। कर्मजानि शरीराणि तथैवाकृतयो नृप॥
en: This is certain, viz., that acts are never destroyed. Bodies, o king, are born of acts; so also are features.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तः स तदा राज्ञा क्षमं बुद्धिमतां हितम्। अनुज्ञाप्य स राजानमहल्यां प्रतिजग्मिवान्॥
en: Thus addressed by the intelligent king about what was beneficial for him, Utanka took leave of the king and set out for the presence of Ahalya.

sa: ऋचश्चाप्यत्र शंसन्ति नारायणविदो जनाः। नारायणाय देवाय यदविन्दन् पशून् पुरा॥
en: People conversant with Narayana, recite some Richs on this subject. Formerly animals were offered to the divine Narayana.

sa: एवं यो वेत्ति विद्वान् वै सदा ब्रह्ममयं रथम्। स धीरः सर्वभूतेषु न मोहमधिगच्छति॥
en: Indeed, that man gifted with learning and wisdom who always understands the Brahmacharin this way, is never possessed by delusion in the midst of all entities.

sa: ऋचश्चाप्यत्र शंसन्ति नारायणविदो जनाः। नारायणाय देवाय यदविन्दन् पशून् पुरा॥
en: People conversant with Narayana, recite some Richs on this subject. Formerly animals were offered to the divine Narayana.

sa: अहल्योवाच परितुष्टास्मि ते विप्र नित्यं भक्त्या तवानघ। पर्याप्तमेतद् भद्रं ते गच्छ तात यथेप्सितम्॥
en: I am highly pleased with you, O learned Brahmana, with your unceasing devotion, O sinless one. This is enough. Blessed be you, go wherever you like.

sa: तेषु तत् कर्म निक्षिप्तं यः स धर्मः सनातनः। यस्तं समभिपद्येत न स दुर्गतिमाप्नुयात्॥
en: Among them is thrown that course of practices which forms eternal Virtue. He who would follow virtue would never have to come by a miserable end.

sa: वर्तमानस्य धर्मेण शुभं यत्र यथा तथा। संसारतारणं ह्यस्य कालेन महता भवेत्॥
en: Deliverance from the world occurs, after a long time, of one who acts righteously and well on every occasion as he should.

sa: तस्माद् विद्धि महाराज मांसस्य परिवर्जनम्। धर्मस्यायतनं श्रेष्ठं स्वर्गस्य च सुखस्य च॥
en: Therefore, O king, know that the discarding of meat is the highest refuge of Religion, of the celestial region, and of happiness.

sa: ऋषीणामत्र संवादो बहुशः कुरुनन्दन। बभूव तेषां तु मतं यत् तच्छृणु युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: Numberless discourses took place. between the Rishis on this subject, O scion of Kuru's race. Listen, O Yudhishthira, what their opinion was.

sa: यथा नागपदेऽन्यानि पदानि पदगामिनाम्। सर्वाण्येवापिधीयन्ते पदजातानि कौञ्जरे॥ एवं लोकेष्वहिंसा तु निर्दिष्टा धर्मतः पुरा। कर्मणा लिप्यते जन्तुर्वाचा च मनसापि च॥
en: As the footprints of all other animals are sunk in those of the elephant, so all other religions are said to be contained in that of mercy. A person becomes guilty of injury through acts, words, and thoughts.

sa: शान्त्यर्थं व्यानमेकं च शान्तिर्ब्रह्म सनातनम्। एतद् रूपमुदानस्य परमं ब्राह्मणा विदुः॥
en: Only Vyana exists for tranquility. Tranquillity is eternal Brahma. This is the excellent scat of Udana as the Brahinanas know.

sa: त्रीन् दोषान् सर्वभूतेषु निधाय पुरुषः सदा। कामक्रोधौ च संयम्य ततः सिद्धिमवाप्नुते॥
en: That man who keeps under restraint the three passions, viz., lust, anger and avarice by throwing them upon all creatures, acquires success.

sa: सुस्वरं रुरुदे धीमान् मातुः पादावुपस्पृशन्। सा च बाष्पाकुलमुखी ददर्श दयितं सुतम्॥
en: Touching the feet of his mother, he began to weep aloud. With tears running down her cheeks, she saw her darling child.

sa: बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य समुन्नाम्य च पुत्रकम्। गान्धार्याः कथयामास सहदेवमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Raising her son up and embracing him with her arms she informed Gandhari of Sahadeva's arrival.

sa: दुर्मरं पुरुषेणेह मन्ये ह्यध्वन्यनागते। यत्र नाहं न मे माता विप्रयुज्येत जीवितात्॥
en: It is clear that one does not die till one's hour comes, since neither myself, nor my mother is deprived of life.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि दश भोज्य नरर्षभ। नरोऽधर्मात् प्रमुच्येत योगेष्वभिरतः सदा॥
en: A person, O king, by feeding ten thousand Brahmanas, becomes cleansed of sin and devoted to Yoga practices.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अन्तरा सायमाशं च प्रातराशं च यो नरः। सदोपवासी भवति यो न भुङ्क्तेऽन्तरा पुनः॥
en: Bhishma said He who takes food only morning and evening at the appointed hours and abstains from all food during the interval, is said to be an abstainer from food.

sa: चिक्षेप च स तं धीमान् वाग्भिरुयाभिरच्युतम्। पुनः पुनश्च मानङ्गः पिबस्वेति तमब्रवीत्॥
en: The intelligent Utanka even began to blame Krishna of undecaying glory. The hunter, however again and again addressed the Rishi, saying, 'Drink!'

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तु राजन्नेतेषामाश्रमे पुण्यकर्मणाम्। शिवा नक्षत्रसम्पन्ना सा व्यतीयाय शर्वरी॥
en: They passed that night which was marked out by auspicious constellations thus, o king, in that hermitage of pious ascetics.

sa: अपां धातू रसो नित्यं जिह्वया स तु गृह्यते। जिह्वास्थश्च तथा सोमो रसज्ञाने विधीयते॥
en: Taste is the essence of water. That is perceived by the tongue. Soma, who lives in the tongue, is appointed likewise in the perception of taste.

sa: स पृष्टः कुशलं तेन सम्पूज्य मधुसूदनम्। उत्तङ्को ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठस्तत: पप्रच्छ माधवम्॥
en: That foremost of Brahmanas, viz., Utanka, politely accosted by Madhava, honoured him duly and then addressed him in these words.

sa: दण्डं समुन्दरं शूलमग्निकुम्भं च दारुणम्। असिपत्रवनं घोरवालुकं कूटशाल्मलीम्॥ एताश्चान्याश्च बह्वीश्च यमस्य विषयं गतः। यातनाः प्राप्य तत्रोग्रास्ततो वध्यति भारत॥
en: Clubs with heavy hammers and mallets sharppointed lances heated jars, dreadful sword blades heated sands, thorny Shalmalisthese and many other engines of torture such a man has to suffer in the regions of Yama, O Bharata,

sa: शुक्राच्छोणितसंसृष्टात् पूर्वं प्राणः प्रवर्तते। प्राणेन विकृते शुक्ते ततोऽपानः प्रवर्तते॥
en: From the semen, united with blood, first originates Prana. Upon the semen being modified by Prana, flows Apana.

sa: प्रतोदेन व्रणा ये मे सभार्यस्य त्वया कृताः। तान् न पश्यामि गात्रेषु स्वस्थोऽस्मि सह भार्यया।।६१
en: I do not any longer see those wounds that were caused by you on our bodies with your good! Verily, with my wife, I am in good health.

sa: मन्त्री उवाच उपधिं शङ्कमानास्ते हित्वा तानि फलानि वै। ततोऽन्येनव गच्छन्ति विदितं तेऽस्तु पार्थिव॥
en: The ministers said O king, coming to know of the existence of gold within the figs, the Rishis have departed. Let this be known to you.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्त्वा हेमगर्भाणि हित्वा तानि फलानि वै। ऋषयो जग्मुरन्यत्र सर्व एत धृतव्रताः॥
en: Bhishma said Having said these words, those Rishis of steadfast vows, abandoning the figs having gold within them, left that place and proceeded where they liked.

sa: देवमत उवाच केनायं सृज्यते जन्तुः कश्चान्यः पूर्वमेति तम्। प्राणद्वन्द्वं च मे ब्रूहि तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्च यत्॥
en: Devamata said-By whom is a creature produced? Who (amongst) them comes first? Tell me what the pairs are of the vital airs, which move transversely, upwards, and downwards.

sa: तत् प्रत्ययकरं लस्वा सुग्रीवं प्लवगाधिपम्। पृथिव्यां वानरैश्वर्ये स्वयं रामोऽभ्यषेचयत्॥
en: Having obtained this token, Rama installed Sugriva the monkey-king, in sovereignty over all the monkeys on earth. a

sa: योऽयं धुरं धुर्यवरो वामा वहति शोभनः। तं मन्ये मेघपुष्पस्य जवेन सदृशं हयम्॥
en: The other beautiful steed, the best of its race, that is yoked to the left pole, is, I think, equal in speed to Meghapushpa.

sa: अय कपाटेन जघान पाण्ड्यं तथा कलिङ्गान् दन्तकूरे ममर्द। अनेन दग्धा वर्षपूगान् विनाथा वाराणसी नगरी सम्बभूव॥
en: He by striking his breast slew the king of Pandya and vanquished the Kalingas in battle; burnt by the city of Varanasi for series of years remained without a lord.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अविजातो विजातस्य मौाद् धूर्तस्य पश्यतः। परिदेवयते मन्दः सकाशे सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The coward and foolish Uttara began to bewail out of foolishness before Savyasachin who was high-spirited and disguised. Uttara said

sa: दृष्ट्वैव हि कुरूनेतान् व्यूढानीकान् प्रहारिणः। हृषितानि च रोमाणि कश्मलं चागतं मम॥
en: Beholding these Kurus, expert in fight, arrayed in battle order I am beside myself with fear and my hairs have stood erect.

sa: बृहस्पतिस्तु पप्रच्छ ब्रह्माणं काविमाविति। भवन्तं नोपतिष्ठेते तौ नः शंस पितामहः॥
en: Brihaspati too asked Brahma "who are these two, who, 0 O grandsire, without worshipping you, go away. Tell us that.”

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच यावेतौ पृथिवीं द्यां च भासयन्तौ तपस्विनौ। ज्वलन्तौ रोचमानौ च व्याप्यातीतौ महाबलौ॥
en: Brahma said These two ascetics blazing, as it were with beauty and illuminating the earth and heaven and possessed of great energy went away.

sa: एतौ हि कर्मणा लोकं नन्दयामासतुवि॒वम्। द्विधाभूतौ महाप्राज्ञौ विद्धि ब्रह्मन् परंतपौ। असुराणां विनाशाय देवगन्धर्वपूजितौ॥
en: These two by their acts ever bring rejoicing to the words; they worshipped by the gods and the Gandharvas live for the destruction of the Asuras.

sa: तदनीकं महत् तेषां विबभौ सागरोपमम्। सर्पमाणमिवाकाशे वनं बहुलपादपम्॥
en: And they saw their army arranged in battle array. That huge army appeared like an ocean.

sa: पद्मस्य भित्त्वा नालं च विवेश सहिता तया। विसतन्तुप्रविष्टं च तत्रापश्यच्छतक्रतुम्॥
en: Seeing her lord staying there in a diminutive form, the goddess too assumed a diminutive form and so did Upashruti.

sa: तमुत्तरं वीक्ष्य रथोत्तरे स्थितं बृहन्नलायाः सहितं महाभुजम्। स्त्रियश्च कन्याश्च द्विजाश्च सुव्रताः प्रदक्षिणं चक्रुरथोचुरङ्गनाः॥
en: Beholding the mighty-armed Uttara seated on the excellent car along with Brihannala, the females, the maidens and the Brahmanas of hard vows, went round the car.

sa: सनत्सुजात उवाच यत् तच्छूक्रं महज्ज्योतिर्दीप्यमानं महद् यशः। तद् वै देवा उपासते तस्मात् सूर्यो विराजते। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: Sanat-Sujata said That which is the seed (of the universe) blazes with great effulgence and is of great fame. The gods worship him; from him shines the sun; the ascetics perceive that Lord who is Eternal.

sa: दुर्जातेः सूतपुत्रस्य शकुनेः सौबलस्य च। तथा क्षुद्रस्य पापस्य भ्रातुर्दुःशासनस्य च॥
en: The son of Suta, a low born fellow, Shakuni, the son of Subala and your little minded vicious brother Dushasana.

sa: सहितान् हि कुरून् सर्वानभियातो धनंजयः। प्रमथ्य चाच्छिनद् वासः किमयं प्रोषितस्तदा॥
en: When Dhananjaya rushing against all the Kurus and smashing them dispossessed them of their clothes, what did he then do.

sa: ननु तत्रापि भीमेन पार्थेन च महात्मना। यमाभ्यामेव संगम्य गन्धर्वास्ते पराजिताः॥
en: Even in that case it was Bhima and the large minded Partha, who aided by the twins vanquished those Gandharvas.

sa: अनादृत्य तु तद् वाक्यमर्थवद् द्रोणभीष्मयोः। ततः स संजयं राजा पर्यपृच्छत पाण्डवान्॥
en: Minding not however the speeches of Drona and Bhishma, which were good advice, the king asked Sanjaya about the sons of Pandu.

sa: सा सारथ्यं मम भ्रातुः कुरु साधु बृहन्नले। पुरा दूरतरं गावो ह्रियन्ते कुरुभिर्हि नः॥
en: Our kine (by this time) have been taken away to a greater distance by the Kurus. If you do not comply with my words as requested.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तां दृष्ट्वा विशालाक्षीं राजपुत्री सखीं तथा। प्रहसन्नब्रवीद राजन् किमागमनमित्युत॥
en: Beholding his friend the princess of expansive eyes in that condition, her friend (Arjuna) o king, smilingly asked her of the cause of coming.

sa: पश्येयुरद्य मे वीर्यं कुरवस्ते समागताः। किं नु पार्थोऽर्जुन: साक्षादयमस्मान् प्रबाधते॥
en: The assembled Kurus shall see today my prowess: (and they shall say). “Is it Arjuna's self who is contending us?”

sa: शस्त्राणि न प्रकाशन्ते न प्रहृष्यन्ति वाजिनः। अग्नयश्च न भासन्ते समिद्धास्तन्न शोभनम्॥
en: Our arms do not shine, our horses are dispirited and our fires, although fuel is added to them, do not blaze up.

sa: प्रत्यादित्यं च नः सर्वे मृगा घोरप्रवादिनः। ध्वजेषु च निलीयन्ते वायसास्तन्न शोभनम्॥
en: All the animals, looking towards the sun, are yelling dreadfully and the crows are perching on our banners. This is not auspicious.

sa: परिक्रम्य कुरुक्षेत्रं कर्णेन सह कौरवः। शिबिरं मापयामास समे देशे जनाधिप।॥
en: The of Kuru having traversed Kurukshetra in company with Karna placed his camps in a plain, O ruler of men,

sa: तस्य वीर्येण संक्लिष्टा नित्यमेव सुता मम। स एव हेतुर्भेदस्य भीमो भीमपराक्रमः॥
en: O pressed by his strength my sons have ever been; and that Bhima of terrible prowess is the cause of this rupture.

sa: गोपालानां तु घोषस्य हन्यतां तैर्महारथैः। आरावः सुमहानासीत् सम्प्रहारे भयंकरे॥
en: A great cry was set up in that dreadful combat by the cow-herds struck by those inighty car-warriors.

sa: दोषैरेतैर्वियुक्तस्तु गुणैरेतैः समन्वितः। एतत् समृद्धमत्यर्थं तपो भवति केवलम्॥
en: Asceticism devoid of these vices and graced with these virtues becomes eminently successful in achieving prosperity.

sa: न तु मन्ये विघाताय ज्ञानं दुःखस्य संजय। भवत्यतिबलं ह्येतज्ज्ञानस्याप्युपघातकम्॥
en: I consider, O Sanjaya, that knowledge cannot destroy woe; in fact, it is excessive distress that kills knowledge.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यस्य वै नानृता वाचः कदाचिदनुशुश्रुम। त्रैलोक्यमपि तस्य स्याद् योद्धा यस्य धनंजयः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said He, from whom we have never heard an untruthful word, he who has Dhananjaya to fight for him can possess himself the three worlds.

sa: संग्रामांश्च बहूञ्जित्वा लब्ध्वा च विपुलं धनम्। विजित्य च परां सेनां नाहुः किंचन पौरुषम्॥
en: Even having won many a battle, amassed a vast fortune, vanquished their enemies, armies, truly heroic men do not utter a single word of their prowess.

sa: सामर्थ्य किं ततः शोके शोचमानौ प्रपश्यथः। धृतिं गृहणीतमा शत्रून् शोचन्तौ नन्दयिष्यथः॥
en: What do you gain by thus giving way to sorrow? Summon patience. Do not grieve and thus give joy to your enemies.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा च सुसूक्ष्मेण रूपेणावस्थितं प्रभुम्। सूक्ष्मरूपधरा देवी बभूवोपश्रुतिश्च सा॥
en: Beholding there Indra in a form of very minute, goddesses Upashruti and Indrani also became in the form of minuteness.

sa: मूलमेषां महत् कृत्तं साराथी चन्दनं यथा। कर्म कारयिथाः सूत तत्र किं विदुरोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: You have cut the great root of the Sala tree. Actuated by greed when you made them work as slaves what did Vidura say?

sa: सुस्कन्धोऽयं महावृक्षो गदारूप इव स्थितः। अहमेनमपारुज्य द्रावयिष्यामि शात्रवान्॥
en: uprooting this huge tree with a trunk looking like a mace I shall assail the enemies.

sa: कवचानि विचित्राणि मृदूनि च दृढानि च।॥ विराटः प्रादिशद् यानि तेषामक्लिष्टकर्मणाम्। तान्यामुच्य शरीरेषु दंशितास्ते परंतपाः॥ रथान् हयैः सुसम्पन्नानास्थाय च नरोत्तमाः।
en: Those slayers of foes then put on their persons those strong, easy and variegated armours which the king Virata had ordered for (those heroes) of unwearied actions. Then ascending cars drawn by good horses, those best of men,

sa: ततस्त्रयोदशस्यान्ते तस्य वर्षस्य भारत। सुशर्मणा गृहीतं तद् गोधनं तरसा बहु॥
en: Thereupon, O descendant of Bharata, after the expiration of the thirteenth year, Susharma by force seized many of his kine.

sa: यथा सभायां द्यूतं त्वं मातुलेन सहाकरोः। तथा युध्यस्व संग्रामे सौबलेन सुरक्षितः॥
en: As backed by your uncle you played at dice in the assembly hall so do you now fight well-protected by Subala's son?

sa: उलूकं चैव कैतव्यं ये च सारस्वता गणाः। नकुलः कल्पयामास भागं माद्रवतीसुतः॥
en: Uluka, the deceitful one and hordes of Sarasvata tribes have been accepted by Nakula, the son of Madravati; as his own share.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच न सन्ति सर्वे पुत्रा मे मूढा दु तदेविनः। येषां युद्धं बलवता भीमेन रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Dhritarashtra said All my foolish sons, those addicted to the wicked dice who have taken it in their hand to fight with the powerful Bhima, have ceased to exist already.

sa: तस्माद् युद्धोचितं कर्म कर्म वा धर्मसंहितम्। क्रियतामाशु राजेन्द्र सम्प्राप्तश्च धनंजयः॥
en: Whether it is right or not you should, O king, make arrangements speedily for the battle for Arjuna has come.

sa: जघन्यतो वयं तत्र यास्यामो दिवसान्तरे! विषयं मत्स्यराजस्य सुसमृद्धं सुसंहताः॥
en: Following them, we will start the next day, well-prepared, for the prosperous territory of the king of Matsya's.

sa: तस्मात् क्षिप्रं विनिर्यामो योजयित्वा वरूथिनीम्। विभज्य चाप्यनीकानि यथा वा मन्यसेऽनघ॥
en: If you like, O sinless one, we shall speedily issue out by collecting our forces and arranging them in divisions.

sa: क्रूरोऽमर्षी स दुष्टात्मा भुवि प्रख्यातविक्रमः। निहतः स तु गन्धर्वैः पापकर्मा नृशंसवान्॥
en: Crooked, wrathful, wicked-minded, having his powers kuown all over the world, that crucl and vicious one has been slain by the Gandharvas.

sa: रुरूणामिव यूथेषु व्याघ्राः प्रहरतां वराः। वरान् वरान् हनिष्यन्ति समेता युधि पाण्डवाः॥
en: Like tigers in a herd of deer these foremost of strikers, those Pandavas assembled together will kill the principal warriors in battle.

sa: क्षिप्रं बलचतुर्भागं गृह्य गच्छ पुरं प्रति। ततोऽपरश्चतुर्भागो गाः समादाय गच्छतु॥
en: Quickly proceed towards the city with onefourth of the army. Let the other fourth part go away with the kine.

sa: एतेन चाहं सम्प्राप्ता द्रुतं शक्र तवान्तिकम्। जहि रौद्रं महाबाहो नहुषं पापनिश्चयम्॥
en: For this reason have I come to you so soon O Shakra, O you with long arms slay Nahusha of wicked purposes.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत: शारद्वतो वाक्यमित्युवाच कृपस्तदा। युक्तं प्राप्तं च वृद्धेन पाण्डवान् प्रति भाषितम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon Sharadvata's son Kripa said the following words: “What the aged Bhishma has said about the Pandavas is reasonable and suited to the occasion.

sa: द्रोण उवाच एतद् ध्वजाग्रं पार्थस्य दूरतः सम्प्रकाशते। एष घोषः स रथजो रोरवीति च वानरः॥
en: The top of the banner which shines at a distance belongs to Arjuna; this is the rattle of his chariot and this is the monkey which is roaring.

sa: विज्ञाय क्रियतां तस्माद् भूयश्च मृगयामहे। ब्राह्मणैश्चारकैः सिद्धर्ये चान्ये तद्विदो जनाः॥
en: Knowing this, do (what you should); we shall again search them through Brahmana spies, Siddhas and others who know them.

sa: एते चान्ये च भूयांसो देशाद् देशं यथाविधि। न तु तेषां गतिर्वासः प्रवृत्तिश्चोपलभ्यते॥
en: Let those and others make a due search in various countries. My belief is that their movements and whereabouts are not to be known.

sa: अक्षौहिणीभिर्यान् देशान् यामि कार्येण केनचित्। तत्राश्वा मे प्रवर्तन्ते यत्र यत्राभिकामये॥
en: To whatever country I go with my Akshauhinis on any purpose, there my horses move in whatever directions I desire.

sa: यदभिध्याम्यहं शश्वच्छुभं वा यद वाऽशुभम्। नैतद् विपन्नपूर्वं मे मित्रेष्वरिषु चोभयोः॥
en: Whatever happiness or misery I chose to assign to my friends or foes, I have never before been disappointed in.

sa: पितामहश्च द्रोणश्च कृपः शल्यः शलस्तथा। अस्त्रेषु यत् प्रजानन्ति सर्वं तन्मयि विद्यते॥
en: What is know as to the use of weapons to our grandfather, Drona, Kripa, Shalya and Shala, is all present in me.

sa: स हतः पतितः शेते गन्धर्वैर्निशि भारत। अदृश्यमानैर्दुष्टात्मा भ्रातृभिः सह सोदरैः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, that vicioussouled one lies slain on earth with his brother by some invisible Gandharvas at night.

sa: सर्वथा विप्रणष्टास्ते नमस्ते भरतर्षभ। न हि विद्मो मतिं तेषां वासं वापि महात्मनाम्॥
en: They have all perished. We bow to you. O foremost of Bharata. We do no know the movements and whereabouts of those highsouled ones.

sa: शाकुनिक उवाच पाशमेकमुभावेतौ सहितौ हरतो मम। यत्र वै विवदिष्येते तत्र मे वशमेष्यतः॥
en: The fowler said These two united are taking that one net of mine but they will come under my control where they will quarrel.

sa: तस्मिन् पुरे जनपदे संजल्पोऽभूच्च सङ्घशः। शौर्याद्धि वल्लभो राज्ञो महासत्त्वः स कीचकः॥
en: All over the city and provinces, it was widely known that the kings Vallabha and Kichaka were both brave and powerful heroes.

sa: ततो मामुपनेष्यन्ति करिष्यन्ति च ते प्रियम्। ध्रुवं च श्रेयसा राजा योक्ष्यते सह बान्धवैः॥
en: They will then take me away from here and will do what is agreeable to you. Forsooth the king with his friends shall meet with wellbeing.

sa: मां च ब्रुवाणं शुश्रूष कुरूणामर्थदर्शिनम्। द्रोणं कृपं विकर्णं च महाराजं च बाह्निकम्॥
en: Listen therefore to what these seekers of good to the Kurus-Drona, Kripa, Vikarna and the great king Bahlika, say and to myself as well.

sa: त्वया सहोषिता चास्मि त्वं च सर्वैः सहोषिता। क्लिश्यन्त्यां त्वयि सुश्रोणि को नु दुःखं न चिन्तयेत्।।२४
en: I have lived with you and you also have lived with us; why should not one, O you of beautiful hips, feel sorrow for you who are afflicted with sorrow.

sa: न हि दुःखं समाप्नोषि सैरन्ध्री यदुपाश्नुते। तेन मां दुःखितामेवं पृच्छसे प्रहसन्निव॥
en: You shall not meet with grief when Sairandhri does it. You are asking me thus in jest who am stricken with sorrow.

sa: सा तु बुद्धिः कृताप्येवं पाण्डवान् प्रति मे सदा। दुर्योधनं समासाद्य पुनर्विपरिवर्तते॥
en: My inclination through made to turn towards the Pandavas constantly turns away in a contrary; direction by coming in contact with Duryodhana.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सा नर्तनागारे धनंजयमपश्यता राज्ञः कन्या विराटस्य नर्तयानं महाभुजम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said She there the mighty-armed Dhananjaya in the dancing hall giving instructions in dancing to the daughter of the king Virata.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तेन च गान्धारी व्यासश्चात्राजगाम ह। आनीतौ विदुरेणेह सभां शीघ्रं प्रवेशितौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said Gandhari and Vyasa were brought there by him, who was then spoken to. Conducted by Vidura, they quickly entered the Council Chamber.

sa: स कृत्वा पाण्डवान् सत्रं लोकं सम्मोहयन्निव। अधर्मनिरतान् मूढान् दग्धुमिच्छति ते सुतान्॥
en: He, making the Pandavas his instruments, desires to consume your foolish sons, who are attached to vice, sleeping the world in illusion.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दुर्योधन हृषीकेशं प्रपद्यस्व जनार्दनम्। आप्तो न: संजयस्तात शरणं गच्छ केशवम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Duryodhana, have recourse to Hrishikesha or Janardana. Sanjaya, my dear, cver seeks our interests; do you therefore seek refuge under Keshava.

sa: व्यास उवाच प्रियोऽसि राजन् कृष्णस्य धृतराष्ट्र निबोध मे। यस्य ते संजयो दूतो यस्त्वां श्रेयसि योक्ष्यते॥
en: Vyasa said You are, O king, dear to Krishna, O Dhritarashtra; listen to me; since Sanjaya has acted as your ambassador, he will do what is conducive to your interests.

sa: अद्वारेणाभ्यवस्कन्ध निर्जगाम बहिस्तदा। स भीमसेनः प्राकारादारुह्य तरसा दुमम्॥
en: He went out of the palace by a wrong way. Then speedily scaling the walls, Bhimasena.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्यास्ताः कृपणा वाचः कृष्णायाः परिदेवितम्। श्रुत्वैवाभ्यापतद् भीमः शयनादविचारयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing those sorrowful words and bewailing of Krishna, Bhima, without reflecting the least, got up from his bed.

sa: ततस्तु तां समारोप्य निबध्य च सुमध्यमाम्। जग्मुरुद्यम्य ते सर्वे श्मशानाभिमुखास्तदा॥
en: Then binding that youthful damsel and placing her upon the bier they started with great joy towards the cremation ground.

sa: सर्वस्य च सदा ज्ञानात् सर्वमेतं प्रचक्षते। सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितः कृष्णः सत्यपत्र प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Owing to his constant knowledge of everything is he called Sarva. Krishna is established on truth and truth is established on him.

sa: आस्थाय रुचिरं जिष्णो रथं सारथिना मया। कतमं यास्यसेऽनीकमुक्तो यास्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: O Partha, stationed on this beautiful car with myself as charioteer, towards what division of the army shall I go?

sa: यत् तद् द्वादश वर्षाणि वनेषु ह्युषिता वयम्। छद्मना शरदं चैकां धृतराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: For twelve years have the forests been inhabited by us; and at the command of Dhritarashtra have we lived in disguise for another year.

sa: प्रगृह्य तरसा दोर्भ्यां कण्ठं तस्य वृकोदरः। अपीडयत कृष्णायास्तदा कोपोपशान्तये॥
en: Then to console Krishna, Vrikodara got hold of Kichaka's throat with his arms and began to squeeze it.

sa: अविस्थलं वृकस्थलं माकन्दी वारणावतम्। अवसानं च गोविन्द कञ्चिदेवात्र पञ्चमम्॥
en: (The villages were) Avisthala, Vrikasthala, Makandi, Varanavata and any other, O Govinda, for the last or the fifth.

sa: गृहीत्वा कीचकं भीमो विरराज महाबलः। शार्दूलः पिशिताकाक्षी गृहीत्वेव महामृगम्॥
en: Seizing Kichaka, the powerful Bhima began to roar like a hunger tiger that has slain a large animal.

sa: क्रोधाविष्टो विनिःश्वस्य पुनश्चैनं वृकोदरः। जग्राह जयतां श्रेष्ठः केशेष्वेव तदा भृशम्॥
en: Breathing hard again and again in anger, Vrikodara the foremost of the victorious held him up always by the hair.

sa: वेगेनाभिहतो भीमः कीचकेन बलीयसा। स्थिरप्रतिज्ञः स रणे पदान्न चलितः पदम्॥
en: Being struck with great force by the powerful Kichaka, the resolute (Bhima) did not waver a step in the encounter.

sa: ह्रीमान् हि पापं प्रद्वेष्टि तस्य श्रीरभिवर्धते। श्रीमान् स यावद् भवति तावद् भवति पूरुषः॥
en: A man endued with a senses of shame despises sins and his prosperity ever increases. When he becomes endued with prosperity, then he is a man.

sa: ते वयं न श्रियं हातुमलं न्यायेन केनचित्। अत्र नो यतमानानां वधश्चेदपि साधु तत्॥
en: There is no need for us to abandon that prosperity. In this case the death of ourselves, struggling to obtain back our prosperity, would be better.

sa: एको ह्यपि बहून् हन्ति जन्त्येकं बहवोऽष्युत। शूरं कापुरुषो हन्ति अयशस्वी यशस्विनम्॥
en: One man kills many; and many also united kill one. A coward kills a real hero, known to fame, a renowned warrior.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच स्वागतं ते वरारोहे यन्मां वेदयसे प्रियम्। न ह्यन्यं कञ्चिदिच्छामि सहायं वरवर्णिनी॥
en: Bhimasena said O fair and timid lady, I shall do what you say, welcome, O fair damsel, you, who have communicated this pleasant news to me.

sa: प्रतीच्छ त्वं मया दत्तमभिषेकं नृपो भव। प्रशाधि पृथिवीं स्फीतां कर्णसौबलपालिताम्॥
en: Accepting this installation offered by me, becorne king. Rule over the earth protected by Karna and the son of Subala.

sa: न हि नः प्रीणयेद् द्रव्यं न देवत्वं कुतः सुखम्। न च सर्वामरैश्वर्यं तव द्रोहेण माधव॥
en: The gain of our object will not make us cheerful and what happiness shall we obtain from god-ship or the lordship over the immortals, if any ill happens to you.

sa: यथैताः कीर्तिता नार्यो रूपवत्यः पतिव्रताः। तथा त्वमपि कल्याणि सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः॥
en: As these beautiful and chaste ladies are described by me, so also, by you, O auspicious one, appear endued with every virtue.

sa: एताश्चान्याश्च परुषा वाचः स समुदीरयन्। श्लाघते ज्ञातिमध्ये स्म त्वयि प्रव्रजिते धनम्॥
en: He pronounced these cruel words and others and he expressed plea are among his cousins at your being exiled into the forest.

sa: पश्य कौन्तेय पाणी मे नैवाभूतां हि यौ पुरा। इत्यस्य दर्शयामास किणवन्तौ करावुभौ॥
en: O Kunti's son, behold these hands of mine, they were not so before.” Saying this she showed both of her hands marked with corns.

sa: पश्य पाण्डव मेऽवस्थां यथा नार्हामि वै तथा। युष्मासु ध्रियमाणेषु पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम्॥
en: Though all of you are alive, behold O Pandava, my plight. It is such as is quite undeserving of me. Lo! how times change.

sa: यात्वा चाहं कुरून् सर्वान् युष्मदर्थमहापयन्। यतिष्ये प्रशमं कर्तुं लक्षयिष्ये च चेष्टितम्॥
en: Going to all the Kurus, I shall seek to effect peace without any sacrifice of your interests; and shall observe their intentions.

sa: सर्वथा युद्धमेवाहमाशंसामि परैः सह। निमित्तानि हि सर्वाणि तथा प्रादुर्भवन्ति मे॥
en: I anticipate war with the enemy by all mcans. It seems to me that all the signs indicate the same.

sa: भीम उवाच यथा यथैव शान्तिः स्यात् कुरूणां मधुसूदन। तथा तथैव भाषेथा मा स्म युद्धेन भीषयेः॥
en: Bhima said In such a way that there may be peace among the Kurus, O slayer of Madhu, should you speak. Do not frighten them with the prospect of war.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा व्यापृतं गोषु वत्सचर्मक्षपाशयम्। सहदेवं युधां श्रेष्ठं किं नु जीवामि पाण्डव।॥
en: Beholding that Sahadeva, the best of warriors, engaged in tending kine and lying on calf skins at night, O Pandava, how can I live?

sa: न विन्दामि महाबाहो सहदेवस्य दुष्कृतम्। यस्मिन्नेववंविधं दुःखं प्राप्नुयात् सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: 0 mighty-armed one, I know not of Sahadeva's sin for which that one of unfailing prowess suffers thus.

sa: तस्मादनभिरूपाभिर्वाग्भिर्मा त्वं समर्छसि। कथं हि भीमसेनं मां जानन् कश्चन माधव॥
en: For this reason you find fault with me in words that I dot deserve. Who, knowing me to be Bhimasena.

sa: अभिवाद्य महाबाहुः सामपूर्वमिदं वचः। उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा कौन्तेयः परवीरहा।॥
en: Saluting him, the mighty-armed son of Kunti, the slayer of hostile heroes, said in sweet and becoming words.

sa: द्रष्टा मां त्वं च लोकश्च विकर्षन्तं वरान् वरान्। न मे सीदन्ति मज्जानो न ममोद्वेपते मनः॥
en: You will see and the world will see me cutting down the foremost warriors. The marrow of my bones is not wasted away; nor does my mind shake with fear!

sa: तदिदं भाषितं वाक्यं तथा च न तथैव तत्। न चैतदेवं द्रष्टव्यमसाध्यमपि किंचन॥
en: These words spoken by you may or may not be true; but there is nothing which ought to be regarded as incapable of attainment.

sa: गच्छ सैरन्ध्र गन्धर्वाः करिष्यन्ति तव प्रियम्। व्यपनेष्यन्ति ते दुःखं येन ते विप्रियं कृतम्॥
en: Retire, O Sairandhri, the Gandharvas will do what is agreeable to you. They will dispel your sorrow and make away with him who has wronged you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सम्पूजयन्तस्ते कृष्णां प्रेक्ष्य सभासदः। युधिष्ठिरस्य कोपात् तु ललाटे स्वेद आगमत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said While the courtiers, seeing Krishna, were praising her in this way, there came from ire the drops of perspiration on the forehead of Yudhishthira.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवंविधैर्वचोभिः सा तदा कृष्णाश्रुलोचना। उपलाभत राजानं मत्स्यानां वरवर्णिनी॥
en: Vaishampayana said With words like these the graceful Krishna, with eyes teeming with tears, rebuked the king of the Matsya.

sa: पश्चादपि नरश्रेष्ठं तव तापो भविष्यति। तान् वा हतान् सुतान् वापि श्रुत्वा तदनुचिन्तय॥
en: Afterwards, O chief among men, you will have repentance at hearing of the death of the Pandavas or of your sons. Think of this.

sa: एवं लोके यशः प्राप्तं भविष्यति नराधिप। वृद्धेन हि त्वया कार्यं पुत्राणां तात शासनम्॥
en: By doing this, you will obtain fame in this world, O ruler of men. O sire, your sons should be controlled by you who are old.

sa: प्रसादं कुरु वीराणां पाण्डवानां विशाम्पते। दीयन्तां ग्रामकाः केचित् तेषां वृत्त्यर्थमीश्वर॥
en: Do you favour the heroic Pandavas, O Lord the universe. Give them some few villages for their living, O Lord.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं वदति वाक्यं तु युयुधाने महामतौ। सुभीमः सिंहनादोऽभूद् योधानां तत्र सर्वशः॥
en: Vaishampayana said While Suyodhana of large mind was yet speaking such, a terrible roar like that of a lion came from all the soldiers assembled there.

sa: एवं तौ स्वर्णविकृतान् विमुञ्चन्तौ महाशरान्। आकाशं संवृतं वीरावुल्काभिरिव चक्रतुः॥
en: Those heroes, then shooting their golden arrows, enveloped, as it were the welkin with a downpour of fire-brands.

sa: सुता मे पञ्चभिर्वीरैः पञ्च जाता महारथाः। अभिमन्युर्यथा कृष्ण तथा ते तव धर्मतः॥
en: By the five heroes are born of me five sons, great car-warriors, who morally bear the same relation with you, O Krishna, as Abhimanyu.

sa: तस्मिन् कृते तदा देवी कीचकेनोपमन्त्रिता। सुदेष्णा प्रेषयामास सैरन्ध्रीं कीचकालयम्॥
en: This being done Sudeshna as previously intimated by Kichaka sent her Sairandhri to the abode of Kichaka, saying.

sa: पञ्च च महावीर्याः पुत्रा मे मधुसूदन। अभिमन्युं पुरस्कृत्य योत्स्यन्ते कुरुभिः सह॥
en: And my five sons, too, O slayer of Madhu, of great heroism, having placed Abhimanyu in the front will fight the Kurus.

sa: न कातरं स्यान्मम जातु वाहनं न मेऽस्ति दुष्टा वडवा कुतो हयाः। जनस्तु मामाह स चापि पाण्डवो युधिष्ठिरो ग्रन्थिकमेव नामतः॥
en: Under my care hardly does any animal fall ill. What to speak of horses even mares in my hands are not to be found wicked. People called me by name, Granthika so also Yudhishthira the son of Pandu.

sa: ततो वृन्देन महता स्थानां रथयूथपः। आचार्यपुत्रः सहसा पाण्डवं पर्यवारयत्॥
en: Then encircled by a vast array of cars, the mighty car-warrior, the son of the preceptor obstructed Partha.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच गायामि नृत्याम्यथ वादयामि भद्रोऽस्मि नृत्ये कुशलोऽस्मि गीते। त्वमुत्तरायै प्रदिशस्व मां स्वयं भवामि देव्या नरदेव नर्तकः॥
en: Arjuna said I sing, dance and play on instruments. I am skilled in dancing and expert in singing. O god among men, assign me to Uttara. I shall be the dancing-master to the princess.

sa: क्षिप्रं च गावो बहुला भवन्ति न तासु रोगो भवतीह कश्चना देतानि शिल्पानि मयि स्थितानि॥
en: I am perfectly aware of the arts by means of which the kine may increase in number within a short time and no disease may come upon them.

sa: तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य भ्राजमानं नरर्षभम्। समुपस्थाय वै राजा पप्रच्छ कुरुनन्दनम्॥
en: The king, seeing that best of men shining in splendour, coming, asked the son of Kuru.

sa: सुदेष्णोवाच मूर्ध्नि त्वां वासयेयं वै संशयो मे न विद्यते। न चेदिच्छति राजा त्वां गच्छेत् सर्वेण चेतसा॥
en: Sudeshna said I can place you on my head, and there is no doubt in that, provided that the king does not desire you and be not captivated with his whole heart.

sa: अश्वत्थाम्नः पुनर्बाणा: क्षिप्रमभ्यस्यतो रणे। जग्मुः परिक्षयं तूर्ममभूत् तेनाधिकोऽर्जुनः॥
en: Ashvathama's arrows however, being speedily discharged, were all exhausted and for this Arjuna beat him down.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच नास्मि देवी न गन्धर्वी नासुरी न च राक्षसी। सैरन्ध्री तु भुजिष्यास्मि सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: or Draupadi said I am neither a goddess nor a Gandharvi nor an Asuri nor a Rakshasi; I am a maid-servant of the Sairandhiri class; I tell you this truth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ते पाण्डवेन समहृष्यद् वृकोदरः। मुहुर्मुहुः क्रोधवशात् प्रावेपत च पाण्डवः॥
en: The son of Pandu (Arjuna) having thus addressed, Vrikodara became greatly pleased; and every moment out of rage, the Pandava's frames shook.

sa: तथा तु विमुखे पार्थे द्रोणपुत्रस्य सायकान्। त्वरिताः पुरुषा राजन्नुपाजह्वः सहस्रशः॥
en: Then Partha going away from the son of Drona, his men, o king, shot thousands of arrows at him (Partha).

sa: तस्मिन् हि यात्रा लोकस्य भूतानामीश्वरो हि सः। तस्मिन् धृतिश्च वीर्यं च प्रज्ञा चौजश्च माधवे॥
en: On him depends the course of the world. He is the lord of all creatures, and in that scion of Madhu's are centered patience, prowess, wisdom and energy.

sa: उत्सृज्य च महाबाहुद्रौणपुत्रं धनंजयः। अभिदुद्राव सहसा कर्णमेव सपत्नजित्॥
en: Leaving behind the son of Drona, the mighty-armed Dhananjaya, the conqueror of enemies, rushed towards Karna.

sa: आविकं च सुखस्पर्श पार्वतीयैरुपाहृतम्। तदप्यस्मै प्रदास्यामि सहस्राणि दशाष्ट च॥
en: Blankets pleasant to touch and procured from hilly tracts shall I give to him eighteen thousand in number.

sa: जलप्रतरणे चैव कान्तारेष्वटवीषु च॥ ये स्मरन्ति महादेवि न च सीदन्ति ते नराः।
en: 0 great goddess, the persons who remember you in the crossing of waters and in the forest and wilderness are never afflicted with calamity.

sa: न च वित्तेन शक्योऽसौ नोद्यमेन न गर्हया। अन्यो धनंजयात् कर्तुमेतत् तत्त्वं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: He cannot, however be separated from Dhananjaya by wealth or by exertions, nor by speaking all about the Pandavas. I tell this you in all sincerity.

sa: रुक्मिण्या हरणं वीरो वासुदेवेन धीमता। कृत्वा प्रतिज्ञा नाहत्वा निवर्तिष्ये जनार्दनम्॥
en: The ravishment of Rukmini (his sister) by the wise Vasudeva; and having resolved "I shall not return without slaying Janardana,"

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच यदाह विदुरः कृष्णे सर्वं तत् सत्यमच्युते। अनुरक्तो ह्यसंहार्यः पार्थान् प्रति जनार्दनः॥
en: Duryodhana said What Vidura has said regarding Krishna has been truly spoken; for Janardana is firmly attached to the son of Pritha and inseparable from them.

sa: न तु तस्मै प्रदेयं स्यात् तथा कार्यगतिः प्रभो। विग्रहः समुपारब्धो न हि शाम्यत्यविग्रहात्॥
en: But circumstances are such, my lord, that nothing should be given him. War having been decided on will not turn into peace by delaying the former.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा घोरं कृष्णाभिसंहितम्। धृतराष्ट्रः सहामात्यो व्यथितो विमनाऽभवत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of terrible import, namely of making of making Krishna a captive, Dhritarashtra with his ministers became oppressed with pain.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इति कर्ण ब्रुवन्नेव बीभत्सुरपराजितः। अभ्ययाद् विसृजन् बाणान् कायावरणभेदिनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having thus spoken to Karna, unconquerable Bibhatsu, encountered him, discharging arrows capable of piercing the coats of mail.

sa: स एव खलु दारुभ्यो यदा निर्मथ्य दीप्यते। तद् दारु च वनं चान्यन्निर्दहत्याशु तेजसा॥
en: That thing (fire) when produced by friction of different pieces of wood burns by its excessive energy those woods and the forest along with other things.

sa: बलं पञ्चविधं नित्यं पुरुषाणां निबोध मे। यत् तु बाहुबलं नाम कनिष्ठं बलमुच्यते॥
en: Men have always five sorts of strength, listen to me, O king. What is called strength of arms is said to be the worst.

sa: यस्यात्मा विरतः पापात् कल्याणे च निवेशितः। तेन सर्वमिदं बुद्धं प्रकृतिर्विकृतिश्च य॥
en: All this, whether natural or artificial, is known by him whose soul has been separated from evils and fixed on good things.

sa: अन्यस्मिन् प्रेष्यमाणे तु पुरस्ताद् यः समुत्पतेत्। अहं किं करवाणीति स राजवसतिं वसेत्॥ सदाऽऽत्मनो
en: He who steps forward saying "pray, I will do it," when another is entrusted with a work, is alone worthy of living in a royal residence.

sa: तव पुत्रशतं चैव कर्णः पञ्च च पाण्डवाः। पृथिवीमनुशासेयुरखिलां सागराम्बराम्॥
en: Your hundred sons and Karna and the five Pandavas can rule the whole world bounded by the seas.

sa: ऐश्वर्यं प्राप्य दुष्प्रापं प्रियं प्राप्य च राजतः। अप्रमत्तो भवेद् राज्ञः प्रियेषु च हितेषु च॥
en: A person, obtaining from the king wealth and other agreeable things hard to acquire, must employ himself assiduously in doing for him what is both pleasant and profitable.

sa: न मां माधव वैधव्यं नार्थनाशो न वैरता। तथा शोकाय दहति यथा पुत्रैर्विनाभवः॥
en: O Madhava, neither widowhood, nor the loss of wealth, nor even this dispute has pained me so much as my separation from my sons.

sa: सेनाग्रमाशु भीष्मस्य प्रापयस्वैतदेव माम्। आच्छेत्स्याम्यहमेतस्य धनुर्ध्यामपि चाहवे॥
en: Take me again before Bhishma's army. I shall cut off his bowstring in battle.

sa: यथा न दुहृदः पापा भवन्ति सुखिनः पुनः। कुर्यास्तत् त्वं हि कल्याणि लक्षयेयुर्न ते तथा॥
en: O blessed one, you should behave yourself in such a way that the wicked and sinful men inay have no chance of deriving pleasure from looking at you.

sa: वृषभानपि जानामि राजन् पूजितलक्षणान्। येषां मूत्रमुपाघ्राय अपि वध्या प्रसूयते॥
en: I also know the bulls bearing favourable marks whose urine on being smelt makes even the barren productive.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाश्चासितस्तेन वैराटिः सव्यसाचिना। व्यवागाहद् स्थानीकं भीमं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्॥
en: Thus consoled by Savyasachin the son of Virata entered into that dreadful array of cars protected by Bhishma.

sa: त्वं त्राता त्वं महद् ब्रह्म त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। यथैवात्य तथैवैतत् त्वयि सत्यं भविष्यति॥
en: You are the saviour, you are the great Brahma, everything depends on you; what you have must come to pass for truth itself depends on you.

sa: तत् कर्म यानि यानि च कर्माणि तस्य वक्ष्यामहे वयम्। आसाद्य मत्स्यं प्रबूत कुरुनन्दनाः॥
en: Tell me, O sons of Kuru, in what capacities we shall have to present ourselves after we shall have gone to the king of the Matsya.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्यं नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्॥
en: Having saluted Narayana and Nara the best of male beings as also the goddess of learning let us cry success.

sa: निर्याय च महाबाहुर्वासुदेवो महामनाः। निवेशाय ययौ वेश्म विदुरस्य महात्मनः॥
en: And the large minded Vamadeva of long arms, coming out went to the residence of the great-souled Vidura.

sa: विष्णुना वसता चापि गृहे दशरथस्य वै। दशग्रीवो हतश्छन्नं संयुगे भीमकर्मणा॥
en: And also living disguised in the abode of Dasharatha, the dreadful acted Lord Vishnu killed the ten-necked Ravana in battle.

sa: प्रच्छन्नं चापि धर्मज्ञ हरिणारिविनिग्रह। वलां प्रविश्य शक्रस्य यत् कृतं तच्च ते श्रुतम्॥
en: How Hari for the purpose of overcoming his enemies, entered into Shakra's thunderbolt lying unrecognized there, O skilled in duly, have you heard this?

sa: तथा तैरवकीर्णस्य दिव्यैरस्त्रैः समन्ततः। न तस्य व्यङ्गुलमपि विवृतं सम्प्रदृश्यते॥
en: He being thus covered with celestials weapons, not even a space measuring two fingers was seen on him.

sa: प्रध्याय शङ्ख गाङ्गेयो धार्तराष्ट्रान् प्रहर्षयन्। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य बीभत्सुं समवारयत्॥
en: Blowing his conch and cheering up the son of Dhritarashtra, the son of Ganga encountered Bibhatsu.

sa: मम हि भ्रातर इमे सहस्रशतयोधिनः। तं योधं न प्रपश्यामि येन सर्वे निपातिताः॥
en: Each of these my brothers is able to fight a thousand warriors and I do not find any warrior capable of destroying them all.

sa: यक्ष उवाच कोऽहङ्कार इति प्रोक्तः कश्च दम्भः प्रकीर्तितः। किं तद् दैवं परं प्रोक्तं किं तत् पैशुन्यमुच्यते॥
en: The Yaksha said : What is spoken of as pride? What is it that is called hypocrisy? What is said to be the grace of the gods? And what is called wickedness?

sa: यक्ष उवाच किं नु हित्वा प्रियो भवति किं नु हित्वा न शोचति। । किं नु हित्वार्थवान् भवति किं नु हित्वा सुखी भवेत्॥
en: The Yaksha asked What is it, the renunciation of which makes one dear? What is that which if given up, does not lead to misery? What is that renouncing which one become wealthy? And what is it the renunciation of which makes one happy?

sa: यक्ष उवाच किमेकं यज्ञियं साम किमेकं यज्ञियं यजुः। का चैषां वृणुते यज्ञं कां यज्ञो नातिवर्तते॥
en: The Yaksha said: What is that one thing) which is the sacrificial Soma? What is that which constitutes the sacrificial Yaju? What is that which sacrifice can not do without?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तामभयां वाचं श्रुत्वा योधाः समागताः। आयुः कीर्तियशोदाभिस्तमाशीर्भिरनन्दयन्॥
en: Hearing these words of assurance, the warriors blessed him by praising his illustrious deeds and wishing him a long life.

sa: कर्ण उवाच संशयं परमं प्राप्य विमोक्ष्ये वासवीमिमाम्। यथा मामात्थ शक्र त्वं सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Karna said : I tell you truly, O Shakra, that according to your directions I will hurl this Vasavi weapon only when my life is in great jeopardy.

sa: इति ब्रुवन्नन्वचरत् स राजा पृथिवीमिमाम्। दर्पण महता मत्तः कंचिदन्यमचिन्तयन्॥
en: Saying thus he would wander over the earth intoxicated with great vanity and without thinking of anything else.

sa: कर्ण उवाच वर्मणा कुण्डलाभ्यां च शक्तिं मे देहि वासव। अमोघां शत्रुसंघानां घातिनी पृतनामुखे॥
en: Karna said: In exchange for my armour and ear-rings, O Vasava, bestow on me an infallible dart, destructive of hostile forces when drawn up in battle-array.

sa: जित्वा त्रिगर्तान् संग्रामे गाश्चैवादाय सर्वशः। अशोभत महाराज सहपार्थः श्रिया वृतः॥
en: Having defeated the Trigartas in battle and rescued the kine, the king shone there, in the inidst of the Partha's.

sa: विदितो देवदेवेश प्रागेवासि मम प्रभो। न तु न्याय्यं मया दातुं तव शक्र वृथा वरम्॥
en: "O lord, O god of gods, I knew before that you (would come). O Shakra, it is not proper for me to bestow on you a boon uselessly.

sa: तस्माद् गच्छन्तु मे योधा बलेन महता वृताः। उत्तरस्य परीप्सार्थं ये त्रिगतैरविक्षताः॥
en: Let those of my warriors, who have not been wounded by Trigartas, go out with a highly powerful army to rescue Uttara."

sa: वृद्धप्रज्ञः पुण्यमेव नित्यमारभते नरः। पुण्यं कुर्वन् पुण्यकीर्तिः पुण्यं स्थानं स्म गच्छति। तस्मात् पुण्यं निषेवेत पुरुषः सुसमाहितः॥
en: An old man and wise always does virtuous acts. By doing virtuous acts he gains a good reputation and goes to a holy place (hereafter). Therefore should a man intently practice virtue.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् प्रीतमना मातलि रदं वचः। एष मे रुचितस्तात जामाता भुजगोत्तमः॥
en: Then did Matali, being of heart, speak to Narada these words-'O Sire, this best of the Naga race selected son-in-law.'

sa: नष्टप्रज्ञः पापमेव नित्यमारभते नरः। पुण्यं प्रज्ञां वर्धयति क्रियमाणं पुनः पुनः॥
en: The man who has lost his wisdom constantly commits sin. The virtuous acts being done again and again increase wisdom.

sa: सर्वान् महीपान् सहितान् कुरुश्च तथैव देवासुरसिद्धयक्षान्। अलं विजेतुं समरे सुतस्ते स्वनुष्ठितः सारथिना हि तेन॥
en: Well guarded by that charioteer, your son will be able to defeat all the kings allied with the Kurus, as well as all the celestials, Asuras and Yakshas.

sa: भार्ययाऽनु स सम्मन्त्र्य सह रात्रौ सुधर्मया। मातलि गलोकाय चकार गमने मतिम्॥
en: Having consulted with his wife, Sudharma, at night (one day), Matali made up his mind to enter the world of the Nagas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु धृतराष्ट्रस्य वै सखा। सूतोऽधिरथ इत्येव सदारो जाह्नवीं ययौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said : At this time one Adhiratha of the Suta tribe and a friend of Dhritarashthra's accompanied by his wife came to the Jahnavi (Ganga).

sa: सूर्य उवाच अदित्या कुण्डले राज्ञि दत्ते मे मत्तकाशिनि। तेऽस्य दास्यामि वै भीरु वर्म चैवेदमुत्तमम्॥
en: Surya said: O queen, O beauteous and timid damsel, I will bestow on him these ear-rings which were given to me by Aditi and also this excellent armour.

sa: सूर्य उवाच भविष्यति महाबाहुः कुण्डली दिव्यवर्मभृत्। उभयं चामृतमयं तस्य भद्रे भविष्यति॥
en: Surya said : Gentle maiden, your (son) will be mightyarmed, furnished with ear-rings and an impenetrable and celestials armour made of Amrita.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच यदि पुत्रो मम भवेत् त्वत्तः सर्वतमोनुद। कुण्डली कवची शूरो महाबाहुर्महाबलः॥
en: Kunti said : O dispeller of all darkness, if I have a son by powerful and furnished with a coat-of-mail and ear-rings.

sa: सूर्य उवाच गमिष्येऽहं यथा मां त्वं ब्रवीषि तनुमध्यमे। न तु देवं समाहूय न्याय्यं प्रेषयितुं वृथा॥
en: Surya said : O slender-waisted damsel, I will go away as you tell me. (But) it is not proper to send away a deity in vain after having invoked him.

sa: एवं ब्रुवन्तीं बहुशः परिष्वज्य समर्थ्य च। इति चेति च कर्तव्यं राजा सर्वमथादिश॥
en: And when she said thus repeatedly, the king encouraged and embraced her and then instructed her minutely as to what she ought to do.

sa: सुधन्वोवाच पितरं ते गमिष्यावः प्राणयोर्विपणे कृते। पुत्रस्यापि स हेतोहि प्रह्लाद नानृतं वदेत्॥
en: Sudhanvan said We shall go your father after staking our lives. Prahrada will not tell a lie even for the sake of his son.

sa: संगत्या तत्र भगवान् विष्णुरासीच्चतुर्भुजः। ततस्तत् सर्वमाचख्यौ नारदो मातलिं प्रति॥
en: There in his company was the four armed Vishnu and there did Narada tell them all about Matali.

sa: ध्रुवो जयः पाण्डवानामिति मे निश्चिता मतिः। तथा ह्यभिनिवेशोऽयं वासुदेवस्य भारत।॥
en: Victory will surely come to the sons of Pandu; such is my opinion, for such is the purpose of Vasudeva.

sa: अदित्यां य इमे जाता बलविक्रमशालिनः। त्वमेषां किल सर्वेषां बलेन बलवत्तरः॥
en: Among those endued with might and prowess that are begotten in the race of Aditi-you are the strongest in might.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यत्र द्रोणस्तथा भीष्मो द्रौणिर्वैकर्तनः कृपः। दुर्योधनश्च राजेन्द्रस्तथान्ये च महारथाः॥ मरुद्गणैः परिवृतः साक्षादपि मरुत्पतिः। कोऽन्यो वृहन्नलायास्तान् प्रतियुध्येत सङ्गतान्॥
en: Yudhishthira said There, where Drona, Bhishma Drona's son, Vikartanas son, Kripa, the king Duryodhana, and other kings and car-warriors are, and where Indra himself is surrounded by Maruts, who else, save Brihannala, can fight with them, all collectively.

sa: यावान् हि भारः कृत्स्नायाः पृथिव्याः पर्वतैः सह। एकस्या देहशाखायास्तावद् भारममन्यत॥
en: The weight, that was in the earth united with the mountains, was in one branch of the body (of Vishnu).

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान् देवो भानुः स्वर्भानुसूदनः। उवाच तं तथेत्येव कर्णं सूर्यः स्मयन्निव॥
en: Hearing all this, the divine lord Bhanu, the subduer of Svarbhanu (Rahu) spoke to Karna with a smile, "it is all true.”

sa: ततोऽग्नि तत्र संज्वाल्य द्विजास्ते सर्व एव हि। उपासांचक्रिरे पार्थ धुमत्सेनं महीपतिम्॥
en: Markandeya said : Then, O Partha, all those twice born ones kindled a fire and took their seats before the king Dyumatsena.

sa: अनसूयाऽऽर्जवं शौचं संतोषः प्रियवादिता। दमः सत्यमनायासो न भवन्ति दुरात्मनाम्॥
en: Guilelessness, simplicity, sanctity. contentment, sweetness of speech, self-control, truthfulness and steadiness are never the attributes of the wicked.

sa: निजानुत्पततः शत्रून् पञ्च पञ्चप्रयोजनान्। यो मोहान निगृह्णाति तमापद् ग्रसते नरम्॥
en: Misery overtakes the man, who dose not subdue his five soaring foes out of ignorance which have five different objects.

sa: अत्र सामानि गाथाभिः श्रुत्वा गीतानि रैवतः। गतदारो गतामात्यो गतराज्यो वनं गतः॥
en: The Daityas Raivata, having heard the hymns of the Samaveda chanted here, abandoned wife, friends and kingdoms and went into the forest.

sa: अत्र सावर्णिना चैव यवक्रीतात्मजेन च। मर्यादा स्थापिता ब्रह्मन् यां सूर्यो नातिवर्तते॥
en: Here by the son of Savarni and that of Yavakrita was fixed a limit, O Brahmana, which Surya does not pass beyond.

sa: यदि ह्येतत् पतेद् भूमौ रुधिरं मम नस्ततः सराष्ट्रस्त्वं महाराज विनश्येथा न संशयः॥
en: Forsooth, If the blood comes out from my nose, and falls on the ground, O king, you with your kingdom would have been destroyed.

sa: यादसामत्र राज्येन सलिलस्य च गुप्तये। कश्यपो भगवान् देवो वरुणं स्माभ्यषेचयत्॥
en: For ruling over aquatic animals and for the protection of the waters, the illustrious and divine sage Kashyapa anointed Varuna.

sa: महार्णवस्य च रवैः श्रोत्रे मे बधिरे कृते। न शृणोमि न पश्यामि नात्मनो वेद्मि कारणम्॥
en: I am rendered deaf by hearing the loud roar of the great sea; I cannot see nor can hear; indeed I even forget the object of this journey.

sa: नारद उवाच एवं बहु च दीनं च ब्रुवाणं गालवं तदा। प्रत्युवाच व्रजन्नेव प्रहसन् विनतात्मजः॥
en: Narada said Then to Galava, who was lamenting in this way and uttering many sorrowful things, the son of Vinata, while still proceeding along, said in reply laughing.

sa: नारद उवाच अथाह गालवं दीनं सुपर्णः पततां वरः। निर्मितं वाह्निना भूमौ वायुना शोधितं तथा। यस्माद्धिरण्मयं सर्वं हिरण्यं तेन चोच्यते॥
en: Narada said Then did Suparna, the foremost among those possessed of wings, say to the grieving Greeted: "Created by Fire in the Earth and reared up by wind, wealth is called Hiranya for the earth itself named Hiranmaya.

sa: एकतः श्यामकर्णानां शुभ्राणां शुद्धजन्मनाम्। अष्टौ शतानि मे देहि हयानां चन्द्रवर्चसाम्॥
en: Give me eight hundred horses white as the rays of the moon, of good birth and black of one ear.

sa: बहुशो जीयमानस्य कर्म दृष्टं तदैव ते। न चेदेवं करिष्यामो यदयं ब्राह्मणोऽब्रवीत्। ध्रुवं यधि हतास्तेन भक्षयिष्याम पांसुकान्॥
en: You have seen the deeds of him who had been victories on many occasions; if we do not do what this Brahmana has said most certainly shall we be killed by him.

sa: नारद उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राजा हर्यश्वः काममोहितः। उवाच गालव दीनो राजर्षिर्ऋषिसत्तमम्॥
en: Narada said The king Haryashva, that royal sage, hearing these words, senseless with passion, said sorrowfully to that best among the Rishis.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच उभाब्यामभ्यनुज्ञाता सा जगाम यशस्विनी। सह भ; हसन्तीव हृदयेन विदूयता॥
en: Thus permitted by both, the renowned (Savitri) with a smiling (countenance) though with a sorrowful heart accompanied her husband (to the woods).

sa: उपस्थाय स तं विप्रो गालवः प्रतिगृह्य च। कन्यां प्रयातस्तां राजन् दृष्टवान् विनतात्मजम्॥
en: The twice born Galava having then presented himself to him and having taken back the maiden went away and saw the son of Vinata.

sa: अद्य तद् दिवसं चेति हुत्वा दीप्तं हुताशनम्। युगमात्रोदिते सूर्ये कृत्वा पौर्वाहिणकी: क्रियाः॥
en: Then, when the sun rose a couple of hands (on the horizon), Savitri performed her morning devotions and offered oblation to the blazing fire.

sa: एवं तत्राश्रमे तेषां तदा निवसतां सताम्। कालस्तपस्यतां कश्चिदपाक्रामत भारत॥
en: Thus, O Bharata, these good people engaged in asceticism continued to dwell for some time in that hermitage.

sa: विचारश्च समुत्पन्नो निरीक्ष्य नहुषात्मजम्। को न्वयं कस्य वा राज्ञः कथं वा स्वर्गमागतः॥
en: And seeing the son of Nahusha, enquiries were made, who is he, what king's son is he, and how did he come to heaven?

sa: यस्तु पक्वमुपादत्ते काले परिणतं फलम्। फलाद् रसं स लभते बीजाच्चैव फलं पुनः॥
en: And he, who gets ripe fruit in the proper season, gets the juice of the fruits well as other fruits reproduced from the seeds.

sa: गते पितरि सर्वाणि संन्यस्याभरणानि सा। जगृहे वल्कलान्येव वस्त्रं काषायमेव च॥
en: Her father having departed, she cast off all her ornaments and put on barks of trees and cloths dyed red.

sa: नारद उवाच अविघ्नमस्तु सावित्र्याः प्रदाने दुहितुस्तव। साधयिष्याम्यहं तावत् सर्वेषां भद्रमस्तु वः॥
en: Narada said: May your daughter Savitri, be given away without any obstruction. I shall now go away. May you be all happy.

sa: नारद उवाच स्थिरा बुद्धिर्नरश्रेष्ठ सावित्र्या दुहितुस्तव। नैष वारयितुं शक्या धर्मादस्मात् कथंचन॥
en: Narada said: O best of men, your daughter is firm in her resolve. It is impossible to wean her away from virtue.

sa: स्थानं च प्रतिपन्नोऽसि कर्मणा स्वेन निर्जितम्। अचलं शाश्वतं पुण्यमुत्तमं ध्रुवमव्ययम्॥
en: Earned by your deeds you have now come to a place which is stable, eternal sacred, excellent and surely indestructible.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच आसीच्छाल्वेषु धर्मात्मा क्षत्रियः पृथिवीपतिः। धुमत्सेन इति ख्यातः पश्चाच्चान्धो बभूव ह॥
en: Savitri said : There was, in Shalya, a pious Kshatriya king, Dyumatsena by name, who lost his eyes in course of time.

sa: नारद उवाच क्व गदाभूत् सुतेयं ते कुतश्चैवागता नृप। किमर्थं युवती भत्रे न चैनां सम्प्रयच्छसि॥
en: Narada said: O king, where did this your daughter go to and where does she come from? Why do you not bestow this youthful (damsel) on a husband?

sa: गन्धर्व एष वै हन्ता कीचकानां दुरात्मनाम्। । व्याघ्रानृक्षान् वराहांश्च हतवान् स्त्रीपुरे तव॥
en: He is the Gandharva who killed the wicked-souled Kichaka's, and it was he who slew the tigers, bears, and boars in your inner apartment.

sa: जानाति विश्वासयितुं मनुष्यान् विज्ञातदोषेषु दधाति दण्डम्। जानाति मात्रां च तथा क्षमा च तं तादृशं श्रीर्जुषते समग्र॥
en: One who knows how to make other people confident on him, who awards punishment after guilt has been established, knows its proper degree and knows also forgiveness it attended with great prosperity.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं निवेद्य तान् पार्थान् पाण्डवान् पञ्च भूपतेः। ततोऽर्जुनस्य वैराटिः कथयामास विक्रमम्॥
en: Having thus pointed out those five sons of Pandu and Pritha to the king, the son of Virata, then began to describe the prowess of Arjuna.

sa: ततस्ते हरयः सर्वे तच्छ्रुत्वा रामभाषितम्। गतासुकल्पा निश्चेष्टा बभूवुः सहलक्ष्मणाः॥
en: Then, hearing these words of Rama all the monk ys together with Lakshmana became motionless as death itself.

sa: त्वमद्य निशितैर्बाणैर्हत्वा शत्रून् ससैनिकान्। प्रतिनन्दन मां पुत्र पुरा जित्वेव वासवम्॥
en: My son, destroying, today, my enemies together with their followers, increase my delight as you did before by conquering Vasava."

sa: अकृता या प्रहस्तेन कुम्भकर्णेन चानघ। खरस्यापचिति: संख्ये तां गच्छ त्वं महाभुज॥
en: O sinless and mighty-armed one, bring to a (successful) termination the hostilities which even Prahasta and Kumbhakarna could not effect in battle.

sa: सततं निग्रहे युक्त इन्द्रियाणां भवेन्नृपः। ईष्सन्नर्थं च धर्मं च द्विषतां च पराभवम्॥
en: The rulers of men, desirous of obtaining worldly good, virtue and the defeat of his enemies, should constantly employ them-selves in controlling their senses.

sa: तेऽभिपत्य परुं भग्ना हतशेषा निशाचराः। सर्वं राज्ञे यथावृत्तं रावणाय न्यवेदयन्॥
en: And the surviving might-wanderers, who fled (from the battle-field), reaching the city, informed king Ravana of all that had happened.

sa: अयं ह्येषां महाबाहुः सर्वेषां शर्म वर्म च। अस्मिन् गृहीते वरदे ऋषभे सर्वसात्वताम्॥
en: This one of long arms is the refuge and protection of all; and this best among the Satvatas, this giver of boons being captured,

sa: तथैवेन्द्रजितं यत्तं लक्ष्मणो मर्मभेदिभिः। इन्द्रजिच्चापि सौमित्रिं बिभेद बहुभिः शरैः॥
en: Similarly, Lakshmana wounded the exerting Indrajita and Indrajita Lakshmana, by various darts capable of piercing the vital parts.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अन्तःपुरेऽहमुषितः सदा पश्यन् सुतां तव। रहस्यं च प्रकाशं च विश्वस्ता पितृवन्मयि॥
en: Arjuna said Living in your inner apartment, I always saw your daughter. Alone or before all, she always used to confide in me as her father.

sa: रामस्तु शरजालानि ववर्ष जलदो यथा। तानि लङ्कां समासाद्य जघ्नुस्तान् रजनीचरान्॥
en: Rama too, then, poured down showers of arrows like the very clouds. And those arrows reaching Lanka killed many night-rangers.

sa: न त्वहं निन्दितं कर्म कुर्यां पापं कथंचन। पाण्डवार्थं हि लुभ्यन्तः स्वार्थान् हास्यन्ति ते सुताः।।२६
en: But I shall never do an act which is blamable and wicked; these sons of yours will lose their own wealth by coveting the wealth of the Pandavas.

sa: अथ दुर्योधनं राजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽभ्यभाषत। कर्णदुःशासनाभ्यां च राजभिश्चापि संवृतम्॥
en: Then did the Dhritarashtra to Duryodhana and Karna and Dushasana and the kings who surrounded them.

sa: ततस्तौ रावणामात्यौ मन्त्रिणौ शुकसारणौ। चरौ वानररूपेण तौ जग्राह विभीषणः॥
en: And Vibhishana arrested two of Ravana's ministers, Shuka and Sarana, who, disguised as monkeys, came there as spies.

sa: तस्मान्निमन्त्रयेऽहं ते दुहितां मनुजाधिप। शुद्धो जितेन्द्रियो दान्तस्तस्याः शुद्धिः कृता मया।॥
en: O king, I, therefore, wish to have your daughter as my daughter-in-law-pure, selfcontrolled, I am. I thus prove her purity.

sa: न्यमीलयन्त नेत्राणि राजानस्त्रस्तचेतसः। ऋते द्रोणं च भीष्मं च विदुरं च महामतिम्॥
en: The kings, with their hearts, struck with fear, shut their eyes with the exception of Drona, Bhishma and Vidura of great intelligence.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच उक्तं बहुविधं वाक्यं ग्रहणीयं सहेतुकम्। ऋषिभिश्चैव च मया न चासौ तद् गृहीतवान्।॥
en: Vasudeva said Many sorts of speech were made, all of them being acceptable and consistent with reason, by myself and the Rishis but he did not accept these.

sa: प्रविशामो वयं तां तु बहुयोजनमायताम्। सान्धकारां सुविपिनां गहनां कीटसेविताम्॥
en: We then entered it (the cave) extending over many a yojana, dark, woody, deep and infested by insects.

sa: हनुमत्प्रमुखास्ते तु वानराः पूर्णमानसाः। प्रणेतुर्विधिवद् रामं सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणं तथा॥
en: The monkeys, headed by Hanuman and successful in their mission, duly bowed down to Rama, Lakshmana and Sugriva.

sa: निवृत्तवासान् कौन्तेयान् य आहुर्विदिता इति। अनुनीता हि भीष्मेण द्रोणेन विदुरेण च॥
en: Through Bhishina, Drona and Vidura have passed the prescribed period unknown in exile, yet have they said that they have been recognized.

sa: न हि ते गमिष्यन्ति सहामात्या यमस्य सदनं प्रति। युयुधानस्य संरब्धस्य युयुत्सतः॥
en: Then must they with their ministers go to the kingdom of death (Yama); they cannot surely withstand Yuyudhana (myself) determined to fight.

sa: तस्या रुदत्या भाविन्या दीर्धा वेणी सुसंयता॥ ददृशे स्वसिता स्रिग्धा काली व्यालीव मूर्धनि।
en: And while that fair lady was weeping, her long, well-woven, black and glossy, braid hanging down from her head looked like a black snake.

sa: यदा मां चैव भार्यां च द्रष्टाऽसि भृशदुर्बलाम्। न तदा जीवितेनार्थो भविता तव संजय॥
en: When you will see myself your wife very weak (owing to the want of nourishment) then of what use will life be to you, O Sanjaya?

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु विदुरः प्राप्य राजनिवेशनम्। अब्रवीद् धृतराष्ट्राय द्वा:स्थ मां प्रतिवेदय॥
en: Being thus addressed, Vidura, having come to the royal palace, said to the gate keeper-'Announce me to Dhritarashtra.'

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच द्वा:स्थं प्राह महाप्राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रो महीपतिः। विदुरं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि तमिहानय मा चिरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The Lord of the Earth Dhritarashtra of great wisdom, said to his attendant-I desire to see Vidura. Bring him here without delay.

sa: यथा नदति सुग्रीवो बलवानेष वानरः। मन्ये चाश्रयवान् प्राप्तो न त्वं निष्क्रान्तुमर्हसि॥
en: "From the manner in which this powerful monkey Sugriva is roaring, I think he has received assistance. (Therefore) do not go out."

sa: तत् त्वरध्वं नरेन्द्राणां पूर्वमेव प्रचोदने। महद्धि कार्यं वोढव्यमिति मे वर्तते मतिः॥
en: Make haste, therefore, in first sending words to this kings among men. I think that some great event is about to come.

sa: अथत्वां पूजयिष्यामि हत्वा वै सर्वसैन्धवान्। अहं पश्यामि विजयं कृच्छ्रभावितमेव ते॥
en: When you have slain all the Saindhavas and are thus victorious and beyond all your troubles, I shall honour you.

sa: तेन सम्भाध्य पूर्वं तौ सुग्रीवमभिजग्मतुः। सख्यं वानरराजेन चक्रे रामस्तदा नृप॥
en: Having first conversed with him, they both came to Sugriva. O king, Rama then contracted a friendship with the monkey-king.

sa: प्रवृत्तिरुपलब्धा ते वैदेह्या रावणस्य च। तां त्वं पुरुषकारेण बुद्ध्या चैवोपपादय॥
en: You have received intelligence concerning Ravana and the princess of Videha. (Now try to) liberate her by exertion and wisdom.

sa: रावणेन हृता सीता राज्ञा लङ्काधिवासिना। सुग्रीवमभिगच्छस्व स ते साह्यं करिष्यति॥
en: Sita has been abducted by Ravana who lives in Lanka. Go to Sugriva who will help you (to recover her).

sa: अमितौजसे तथोग्राय हार्दिक्यायान्धकाय च। दीर्घप्रज्ञाय शूराय रोचमानाय वा विभो॥
en: And to Hardikya of unequaled prowess and to the haughty Andhaka and Rochamana, the hero of good understanding.

sa: स्खलितार्थ पुनस्तात संत्यजन्ति च बान्धवाः। अप्यस्मिन् नाश्वसन्ते च जुगुप्सन्ते च तादृशम्॥
en: And again friends abandon him who is deprived of his wealth and they even view with suspicion and contempt such a man.

sa: तुण्डश्च दण्डधारश्च बृहत्सेनश्च वीर्यवान्। अपराजितो निषादस्व श्रेणिमान् वसुमानपि॥
en: And Tunda and Dandadhara and the valiant Brihatsena and the unconquered Nishada and Shreniman and Vasuman.

sa: एवं हृतायां वैदेह्यां रामो हत्वा महामृगम्। निवृत्तो ददृशे धीमान् भ्रातरं लक्ष्मणं तथा॥
en: The princess of Videha being thus carried off, the intelligent Rama having slain the great deer on his way back met his brother Lakshmana.

sa: न हि मे मोक्ष्यसे जीवन् यदि नोत्सृजसे वधूम्। उक्त्वैवं राक्षसेन्द्रं तं चकर्त नखरै शम्॥
en: If you do not release my daughter-in-law you must not escape with your life.” Saying thus, he began to pierce the lord to the Rakshasas with his claws.

sa: स ददर्श तदा सीतां रावणाङ्कगतां स्नुषाम्। सक्रोधोऽभ्यद्रवत् पक्षी रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम्॥
en: (When) that bird saw his daughter-in-law in the arms of Ravana he furiously rushed against the lord of the Rakshasas.

sa: स भवान् प्रेषयत्वद्य पाण्डवार्थकरं वचः। सर्वेषां निश्चितं तन्नः प्रेषयिष्यति यद् भवान्॥
en: This day, therefore, tutor us in what is to the interests of the Pandavas. None of us shall question what you say.

sa: द्वारकां तु गते कृष्णे युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। चक्रुः सांग्रामिकं सर्वं विराटश्च महीपतिः॥
en: Krishna having gone to Dwarka the followers of Yudhishthira and also the king Virata made all preparations for the war.

sa: मारीचस्त्वब्रवीच्छ्रुत्वा समासनैव रावणम्। अलं ते राममासाद्य वीर्यज्ञो ह्यस्मि तस्य वै॥
en: On hearing Ravana, Maricha shortly told him “You must not provoke Rama, for I am well aware of his prowess.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच मारीचस्त्वथ सम्भ्रान्तो दृष्ट्वा रावणमागतम्। पूजयामास सत्कारैः फलमूलादिभिस्ततः॥
en: Markandeya said : Seeing Ravana come, Maricha accorded to him a respectful welcome by offering fruits and roots.

sa: नकुलं सहदेवं च बलवीर्यसमन्वितौ। सहायं वासुदेवं च न ऑस्यति युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: And Nakula and Sahadeva, both endued with might and energy and Vasudeva as his allies, Yudhishthira will not forgive anything.

sa: ततो वनं गते रामे राजा दशरथस्तदा। समयुज्यत देहस्य कालपर्यायधर्मणा॥
en: Then Rama having departed to the forest, Dasharatha, following the eternal law of time, gave up the ghost.

sa: विग्रहेऽस्मिन् भवान् साह्यं मम दातुमिहार्हति। समं हि भवतः सख्यं मम चैवार्जुनेऽपि च॥
en: "It is befitting that you should lend me your help in this war, for your friendship with myself and that with Arjuna are equal.

sa: ये चैवान्ये कुरुमुख्या युवानः पुत्रा: पौत्रा भ्रातरश्चैव ये नः। यं यमेषां मन्यसे येन योग्यं तत् तत् प्रोच्यानामयं सूत वाच्याः॥
en: Those others, who are high among the Kurus and young and those who are as sons, grand-sons and brothers to us, should also be asked, O Suta, regarding their health, in terms which you consider suitable for each.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच पितामहस्ततस्तेषां संनिधौ शक्रमब्रवीत्। सर्वैर्दवगणैः सार्धं सम्भव त्वं महीतले॥
en: In their presence then the Grandfather said to Shakra, “You also take your birth on earth, with all these celestials.

sa: उद्यन्मेघस्वनः काले कृष्णः कर्णमथाब्रवीत्। मृदु वा यदि वा तीक्ष्णं तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Speaking with the roar of cloud during the rains, what Krishna told Karna, in words sharp or mind, tell me, O Sanjaya.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच राक्षसस्तु वरं लब्ध्वा दशग्रीवो विशाम्पते। लङ्कायाश्च्यावयामास युधि जित्वा धनेश्वरम्॥
en: Markandeya said : Having obtained this boon, the ten-headed Ravana defeated Kubera in battle and wrested from him the sovereignty of Lanka.

sa: पुरोगमाश्च ते सन्तु द्रविडाः सह कुन्तलैः। आन्ध्रास्तालचराश्चैव चूचुपा वेणुपास्तथा॥
en: Let also the people of Dravida and Kuntala and the Andharas and Talacharas, Chuchupas and Venupas precede you.

sa: स्तुवन्तु त्वां च बहुभिः स्तुतिभिः सूतमागधाः। विजयं वसुषेणस्य घोषयन्तु च पाण्डवाः॥
en: Let professional bards and singers also sing your praise in various songs and let the Pandavas proclaim the victory of the Vasusenas.

sa: ततो ब्रह्मा स्वयं गत्वा तपसस्तान् न्यवारयत्। प्रलोभ्य वरदानेन सर्वानेव पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: Thereupon Brahma, going there himself, made them desist from ascetic observances by promising to confer upon each one of them boons separately.

sa: स्तथाऽऽचार्यानृत्विजो ये च तस्य। तैश्च त्वं तात सहितैर्यथार्ह संगच्छेथाः कुशलेनैव सूत॥
en: You should also meet the priest of Dhritarashtra and all his preceptors and Ritvijas and ask them about their health O Suta.

sa: विमानं पुष्पकं नाम कामगं च ददौ प्रभुः। यक्षाणामाधिपत्यं च राजराजत्वमेव च॥
en: The Lord gave him a chariot coursing at will by name Pushpaka, the sovereignty over he Yakshas and the supremacy over kings.
