sa: अनुयातश्च पितरमधिको वा पराक्रमे। गीतं स्तोत्रं स सौभद्रः सम्यक् तत्र भविष्यति॥
en: Equal to his father or even superior to him in prowess the son of Subhadra will be the Vedic hymn recited there.

sa: स चैव तत्र धर्मात्मा शश्वद् राजा युधिष्ठिरः। जपैोमैश्च संयुक्तो ब्रह्मत्वं कारयिष्यति॥
en: And the virtuous-souled king Yudhishthira, engaged in making Japa and Homa, will perform the office of a Brahmana in the sacrificial rite.

sa: अस्ति नूनं मया कश्चिदल्पभाग्यतरो नरः। भवता दृष्टपूर्वो वा श्रुतपूर्वोऽपि वा भवेत्॥
en: Is there any one indeed who is more unfortunate than I am. Have you heard or seen of any such man before.

sa: प्राजाप्तयं हि नक्षत्रं ग्रहस्तीक्ष्णो महाद्युतिः। शनैश्चरः पीडयति पीडयन् प्राणिनोऽधिकम्॥
en: That active planet of great effulgence Shanaishchara (Saturn) troubles the star Prajapatya indicating greater troubles to living creatures.

sa: निष्टनन्ति च मातङ्गा मुञ्चन्त्यश्रूणि वाजिनः। पानीयं यवसं चापि नाभिनन्दन्ति माधव॥
en: Elephants are making terrific yells and horses are shedding tears and do not take delight in food and drink, Madhava.

sa: अल्पे भुक्ते पुरीषं च प्रभूतमिह दृश्यते। वाजिनां वारणानां च मनुष्याणां च केशव॥
en: Though taking but little food, it is seen that the evacuations of horses, of horses elephants and men are very great in quantity, OKeshava.

sa: विक्रमैस्त्रिभिरक्षोभ्यो जहाराशु स मेदिनीम्। ददौ शक्राय च महीं विष्णुर्देवः सनातनः॥
en: With his three foot-steps he immediately covered the entire earth then the eternal deity Vishnu gave the earth to Shakra.

sa: तव चापि मया कृष्ण स्वप्नान्ते रुधिराविला। अन्त्रेण पृथिवी दृष्टा परिक्षिप्ता जनार्दन॥
en: You, O Krishna, were seen by me in that ocean throwing weapons on the earth which was covered with blood, O Janardana.

sa: न तत्राविदितं ब्रह्माल्लोके भूतेन केनचित्। पुनरुक्तेन किं तेन भाषितेन पुनः पुनः॥
en: Brahmana, what you say is not unknown in this world nor by any being; why do you repeat it again and again?

sa: युधिष्ठिरो मया दृष्टो ग्रसमानो वसुन्धराम्। त्वया दत्तामिमां व्यक्तं भोक्ष्यते स वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Yudhishthira was seen by me to be swallowing this earth and this indicates that he will enjoy this earth given by you.

sa: यूयं सर्वे वधिष्यध्वं तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः। पार्थिवान् समरे कृष्ण दुर्योधनपुरोगमान्॥
en: You will all slay the rulers of the earth having at their head Duryodhana in the battle-I have doubt as to that.

sa: अथवा सङ्गमः कृष्ण स्वर्गे नो भविता ध्रुवम्। तत्रेदानी समेष्यामः पुनः सार्धं त्वयागऽनघ॥
en: Else there will be a meeting between us surely in heaven. I now see that I shall meet you there only, O sinless one.

sa: ईशन्नपि महायोगी सर्वस्य जगतो हरिः। कर्माण्यारभते कर्तुं कीनाश इव वर्धनः॥
en: Though larding over the entire world, Hari, that great anchorite, has recourse to work, as a cultivator tills the soil.

sa: राजानं चाब्रवीद् भीमो द्रौपद्याः कथ्यतामिति। दासभावगतो ह्येष पाण्डूनां पापचेतनः॥
en: Bhima said to the king, “Tell Draupadi, that this vile man has become the slave of the Pandavas."

sa: तत एनं विचेष्टन्तं बद्ध्वा पार्थो वृकोदरः। रथमारोपयामास विसंज्ञं पांसुगुण्ठितम्॥
en: Thereupon taking him who was unconscious and besmeared with dust Partha and Vrikodara placed him on the chariot.

sa: तस्य जानू ददौ भीमो जघ्ने चैनमरलिना। स मोहमगमद् राजा प्रहारवरपीडितः॥
en: Bhima struck him on the breast with his knees and fists, and thus assailed the king soon lost his consciousness.

sa: अनुयाय महाबाहुः फाल्गुनो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। अनेन वीर्येण कथं स्त्रियं प्रार्थयसे बलात्॥
en: The mighty-armed Falguna, following him, said "with such prowess how could you desire to take away a female by force?

sa: अप्सरस ऊचुः तथा यत्नं करिष्यामः शक्र तस्य प्रलोभने। यथा नावाप्स्यसि भयं तस्माद् बलनिषूदन॥
en: The Nymphs said O Shakra, we shall try to decoy him so that, O you slayer of Bala, you may not experience any dread from him

sa: आचार्यो वा महाभाग भारद्वाजः किमब्रवीत्। पिता वा धृतराष्ट्रस्तं गान्धारी वा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: What did the preceptor, endued with noble attributes, the son of Bharadvaja, what did his father and mother-or Dhritarashtra and Gandhari say?

sa: तेषां वाक्यानि गोविन्द श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं विभो। यथा च नाभिपद्येत कालस्तात तथा कुरु। भवान् हि नो गतिः कृष्ण भवान् नाथो भवान् गुरुः॥
en: Their words, O Govinda, do I desire to hear O lord, and act in such a way that time may not be lost, my dear friend; you are our refuge, O Krishna, you are lord, and you are our preceptor.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच न हन्तव्यो महाबाहो दुरात्मापि स सैन्धवः। दुःशलामभिसंस्मृत्य गान्धारीं च यशस्विनीम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O you of mighty arms, remembering our sister Dushala and the illustrious Gandhari, the wicked-minded Saindhava should not be slain by you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तो भीमसेनस्तु गुडाकेशेन धीमता। युधिष्ठिरमभिप्रेक्ष्य वाग्मी वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Being thus accosted by the intelligent Gudakesha, Bhimasena, skilled in speech, turning to Yudhishthira, said,

sa: व्याधीनं प्रणुद् वीर त्वं प्रजा धर्मेण पालय। त्वयि जीवति मा राष्ट्रं विनाशमुपगच्छतु॥
en: Put an end to these calamities, O hero, and rule over your subjects with justice; yourself being alive let not this kingdom meet destruction.

sa: हित्वा सुखं मनसश्च प्रियाणि तेन शक्रः कर्मणा श्रेष्ठ्यमाप। सत्यं धर्मं पालयन्त्रप्रमत्तो दमं तितिक्षां मतां प्रियं च॥
en: Giving up pleasure and the satisfaction of his desires, the position of a chief was obtained by Shakra by means of work. He strictly observed truth, virtue, self-control, forbearance, impartially and amiability.

sa: अतन्द्रिता भारमिमं महान्तं बिभर्ति देवी पृथिवी बलेन। अतन्द्रिताः शीघ्रमपो वहन्ति संतर्पयन्त्यः सर्वभूतानि नद्यः॥
en: The goddess Earth, sleepless, carries this great load through her strength and the sleepless rivers carry their waters with speed, satisfying the desire of all beings.

sa: शल्य उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु तक्षा स महेन्द्रवचनात् तदा। शिरांस्यथ त्रिशिरसः कुठारेणाच्छिनत् तदा॥
en: Shalya said Having heard this, the wood cutter, after the speech of Indra, cut down the heads of the three-headed one with his axe.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा ह्रियमाणां तां राजपुत्रीं यशस्विनीम्। अन्वगच्छत् तदा धौम्यः पदातिगणमध्यगः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this and entered into his rank of infantry he followed that princes, who was being carried away.

sa: वनं गच्छ मया साधु धृतराष्ट्रेण चैव ह। बद्ध्वा वा निकृतिप्रज्ञं धार्तराष्ट्र सुदुर्मतिम्॥
en: Go to the woods in company with myself and Dhritarashtra, or binding down the very wretched intentioned son of Dhritarashtra, whose wisdom is lost,

sa: कृपः शल्यः सौमदत्तिर्विको विविंशतिः कर्णदुर्योधनौ च। एतान् हत्वा कीदृशं तत् सुखं स्याद् यद् विन्देथास्तदनु ब्रूहि पार्थ॥
en: Kripa, Shalya, the son of Somadatta, Vikarana, Vivingshati, Karna and Duryodhana-having killed all these, what sort of happiness is it that you will get after that, tell me, O son of Pritha.

sa: यवीयासं ततः पूरूं पुत्रं स्ववशवर्तिनम्। राज्ये निवेशयामास विधेयं नृपसत्तमः॥
en: Then did place his second son Puru, who remained devoted to him, on the throne which was suitable.

sa: अजानतां ख्यापय नः सुकेशि कस्यासि भार्या दुहिता च कस्य॥
en: O you having fine hair, tell us, who do not know whose wife and whose daughter you are.

sa: महता परिबहेण राजयोग्येन संवृतः। राजभिर्बहुभिः सार्धमुपायात् काम्यक च सः॥
en: Dressed in his best royal robe and accompanied by many princes he halted at the forest of Kamayaka.

sa: तासां ये पतयः सप्त विख्यातास्तान् निबोधत। दुपदश्च विराटश्च धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ॥
en: Listen to the names of those renowned who to be their respective commanders. Drupada, Virata, Dhrishtadyumna and Shikhandin,

sa: व्यास उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा मौद्गल्यो वाक्यं विममृशे धिया। विमृश्य च मुनिश्रेष्ठो देवदूतमुवाच ह॥
en: You have described to me the great draw backs of the celestial region. Now describe to me a region which is free from fault.

sa: क्षत्तुर्यदा नान्ववर्तन्त बुद्धि कृच्छ्रे कुरून् सूत तदाभ्याजगाम्। यावत् प्रज्ञामन्ववर्तन्त तस्य तावत् तेषां राष्ट्रवृद्धिर्बभूव॥
en: When they no longer followed the instructions of Vidura, troubles overtook the Kurus, O Suta. So long as they followed his wisdom, did their kingdom prosper.

sa: एवं संचिन्तयन्नेव शक्रो विष्णुमनुस्मरन्। अथ फेनं तदाऽपश्यत् समुद्रे पर्वतोपमम्॥
en: Thus thinking Shakra invoked Vishnu and then saw coming out of the sea, foam high as a mountain.

sa: स्वागतं तेऽस्त्विति मुनि मुद्गलः प्रत्यभाषत। पाद्यमाचमनीयं च प्रतिपाद्यार्थ्यमुत्तमम्॥ प्रादात् स तापसायान्नं क्षुधितायातिथिव्रती। उन्मत्ताय परां श्रद्धामास्थाय स धृतव्रतः॥ ततस्तदन्नं रसवत् स एव क्षुधयान्वितः। बुभुजे कृत्स्नमुन्मत्तः प्रादात् तस्मै च मुद्गलः॥
en: The Rishi Mudgala replied by saying “Welcome.” Offered to that hungry, mad ascetic, water to wash his feet and mouth; that Rishi, ever observant of the vow of feeding guests, then placed before him excellent food. Affected by hunger, the mad Rishi ate up all the food given to him. Then Mudgala gave him more food.

sa: तं तु शुश्राव धर्मिष्ठं मुद्गलं संशितव्रतम्। दुर्वासा नृप दिग्वासास्तमथाभ्याजगाम ह॥ बिभ्रच्चानियतं वेषमुन्मत्त इव पाण्डव। विकचः परुषा वाचो व्याहरन् विविधा मुनिः॥
en: O king (once upon a time) having heard of the virtuous and bow-observing Mudgala, the naked Rishi Durvasa, with his dress like that of a maniac and his head bare of hair, came there, O Pandava, uttering various insulting words.

sa: यथा किरीटी सर्वाभ्यः सेनाब्यो व्यतिरिच्यते। एवमेव महाबाहुर्वासुदेवो महाद्युतिः॥
en: An Kiritin suppress the entire army, so does Vasudeva of long arms and of great luster.

sa: न युज्यते कर्म युष्मासु हीनं सत्त्वं हि वस्तादृशं भीमसेनाः। उद्भासते ह्यञ्जनबिन्दवक्त च्छुभ्र वस्त्रे यद् भवेत् किल्बिषं वः॥
en: A mean act does not befit you for you are noble-minded and have a terrible army. If you act mean, it will get undue preponderance as does a black spot on a white cloth.

sa: दुर्बलोऽहं न मे शक्तिर्भवतां परिपालने। बलवाञ्जायते राजा बलं शक्रे हि नित्यदा॥
en: I am weak; it is not in my power to protect you. The powerful should make kings, (and) power ever graced Shakra.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच समागताः पाण्डवाः सुंजयाश्च जनार्दनो युयुधानो विराटः। यत् ते वाक्यं धृतराष्ट्रानुशिष्टं गावल्गणे ब्रूहि तत् सूतपुत्र॥
en: Yudhishthira said Here are assembled the sons of Pandu, the Srinjayas, Yudhishthira, Virata; speak the words, you have been instructed to say by Dhritarashtra, O son of Gavalgana, O son of Suta.

sa: तांस्तथेत्यब्रवीद् राजा सर्वभूतहिते रतः। यथा भवन्तो ब्रुवते करिष्यामि च तत् तथा॥
en: The king, ever intent on the welfare of all creatures, said to them "So be it”. I shall act as you say.

sa: स एवमुक्तो नृपतिमुवाच द्विजसत्तमः। न स शक्यः क्रतुश्रेष्ठो जीवमाने युधिष्ठिरे॥ आहर्तुं कौरवश्रेष्ठ कुले तव नृपोत्तमा दीर्घायुर्जीवति च ते धृतराष्ट्र: पिता नृप।॥ अतश्चापि विरुद्धस्ते क्रतुरेष नृपोत्तम।
en: Having been thus addressed that foremost of Brahmanas spoke thus to the king, “You cannot perform that great sacrifice, so long Yudhishthira is alive. O best of the Kurus, O feremost of kings, your long-lived father Dhritarashtra is still alive. For this reason also you cannot perform it. There is.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच जित्वा तु पृथिवीं राजन् सूतपुत्रो जनाधिप। अब्रवीत् परवीरघ्नो दुर्योधनमिदं वचः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, O lord of men, that slayer of hostile heroes, the Suta's son (Karna) then spoke these words to Duryodhana.

sa: एवं विजित्य राजेन्द्र कर्णः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। सपर्वतवनाकाशां ससमुद्रां सनिष्कुटाम्॥ देशैरुच्चावचैः पूर्णा पत्तनैर्नगरैरपि। द्वीपैश्चानूपसम्पूर्णैः पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते॥ कालेन नातिदीर्पण वशे कृत्वा तु पार्थिवान्। अक्षयं धनमादाय सूतजो नृपमभ्ययात्॥
en: O foremost of kings, having thus in a very short time conquered this earth furnished with mountains and forests and skies and with ocean and fields, with high and low tracts and cities and with innumerable islands and thus having obtained inexhaustible wealth, Suta's son presented himself before the king.

sa: तेषामक्षौहिणी सेना बहुला विबभौ तदा॥ विधूयमानो वातेन बहुरूप इवाम्बुदः।
en: And their large army looked beautiful at that time like various sorts of clouds shaken by the winds.

sa: न हि ते पाण्डवाः सर्वे कलामर्हन्ति षोडशीम्। अन्ये वा पुरुषव्याघ्र राजानोऽभ्युदितोदिताः॥
en: O foremost of men, all the Pandavas and other kings who are crowned with success cannot come to sixteenth part of you.

sa: बहुना च किमुक्तेन शृणु कर्म वचो मम। सनाथोऽस्मि महाबाहो त्वया नाथेन सत्तम॥
en: What need is there to speak in length. O Karna, listen to my words. O mighty-armed hero, in you I have got my protector.

sa: एवं व्यूढान्यनीकानि कौरवेयेण धीमता। अक्षौहिण्यो दशैका च संख्याताः सप्त चैव ह॥
en: In this way was the army of the intelligent Kaurava arrayed by him; there were seven and eleven Akshauhini of troops altogether.

sa: सोऽहं भीष्मवचस्तद् वै न मृष्यामीह भारत! त्वत्समक्षं यदुक्तं च भीष्मेणामित्रकर्षण॥ पाण्डवानां यशो राजंस्तव निन्दां च भारता अनुजानीहि मां राजन् सभृत्यबलवाहनम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, O chastiser of focs, I shall never bear the words that Bhishma has said as regards this matter by praising the Pandavas and censuring you. O king, join with me with your attendants, troops and chariots.

sa: तस्मादहं क्षमं मन्ये पाण्डवैस्तैर्महात्मभिः। संधिं संधिविदां श्रेष्ठ कुलस्यास्य विवृद्धये॥
en: Therefore for the welfare of this race, peace is I think most desirable with the sons of Pandu.”

sa: गत्वाब्रुवन् नहुषं तत्र शक्र त्वं नो राजा भव भुवनस्य गोप्ता। तानब्रवीनहुषो नास्मि शक्त आप्यायध्वं तपसा तेजसा माम्॥
en: And going, O Shakra, to Nahusha they said-Be you king, the protector of the worldNahusha said to them-I am not capable of being your king); infuse in me, strength with the virtue of devotion.

sa: अस्या हितं भवेद् यच्च मम चापि हितं भवेत्। क्रियातां तत् सुरश्रेष्ठा नहि दास्याम्यहं शचीम्॥
en: What will be of benefit to her will also be of benefit to me. Do that then, O chief among the gods. I shall not give up Sachi.

sa: तथेति च प्रतिश्रुत्य सा कृत्या प्रययौ तदा। निमेषादगमच्चापि यत्र राजा सुयोधनः॥
en: Thus commanded, she went away saying, "So be it.” In a moment she came to the place where the king, Duryodhana, was.

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच नहुषं याचतां देवी किंचित् कालान्तरं शुभा। इन्द्राणी हितमेतद्वि तथाऽस्माकं भविष्यति॥
en: Brihaspati said Let this auspicious goddess ask time of Nahusha; this will be of benefit to herself and the same to us.

sa: देवा ऊचुः त्वया जगदिदं सर्वं धृतं स्थावजङ्गमम्। एकपल्यसि सत्या च गच्छस्व नहुषं प्रति॥
en: The gods said This entire world, with all its movable and immovable, is held by you, you are an only wife and truthful; go to Nahusha.

sa: अभिप्रयामि संग्रामे यदहं युद्धदुर्मदान्। नाजित्वा विनिवर्तामि तेन मां विजयं विदुः॥
en: When I go out to fight with invincible kings I never return without defeating them; hence they call me Vijaya.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा त्वरावानुत्तरस्तदा। अर्जुनस्यायुधान् गृह्य शीघेणावातरत् ततः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing those words of Arjuna, Uttara became active He quickly got down from the tree with Arjuna's weapon.

sa: क्व नु स्विदर्जुन: पार्थः कौरव्यो वा युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: But where are that Arjuna, the son of Pritha, Yudhishthira of the Kuru race, Nakula, Sahadeva and Bhimasena the son of Pandu?

sa: अहमेव स्मृतो माता पिता पुत्रोऽस्म्यहं पुनः। आत्माऽहमपि सर्वस्य यच्च नास्ति यदस्ति च॥
en: According to the Smritis, I am the mother, the father and again I am the son-I am the soul of everything, past and present.

sa: रणे हते कौरवाणां प्रवीरे शिखण्डिना सत्तमे शान्तनूजे। न जातु नः शत्रवो धारयेयुरसंशयं सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि।।
en: The virtuous son of Shantanu; that hero among the sons of Kuru, being killed in battle by Shikhandin; then our enemies will undoubtedly perish. I speak this truly.

sa: ह्रीमान् मनीषी बलवान् मनस्वी स लक्ष्मीवान् सोमकानां प्रबर्हः। न जातु तं शत्रवोऽन्ये सहेरन् येषां स स्यादग्रणीर्वृष्णिसिंहः॥
en: No foe can withstand them who have for their leader of the lion of the Vrishni race, that chief of the Somaka tribe, who is modest, wise, powerful, independent, blessed with prosperity.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे भीमं क्षेमधूर्तिः पराभिनत्। जघान चास्य द्विरदं नाराचैः सर्वमर्मसु॥
en: Then highly wrathful Kshemadhurti struck Bhima in the battle and killed the elephant by piercing all his vital parts with his arrows.

sa: भेरीशब्देन महता मृदङ्गानां स्वनेन च। गजानां हितैश्चापि तुरङ्गाणां च हृषितैः॥
en: (Mingling) with the loud beat of drums and sound of cymbals, the grunt of elephants and the neigh of horses.

sa: रक्षमाणः स्वकं व्यूह द्रोणोऽपि सह सैनिकैः। अयोधयद् रणे पार्थान् प्रार्थयानो महद् यशः॥
en: Drona also, desirous of winning great fame, fought on with the Parthas, protecting his array and helped, in the encounter, by his own troops.

sa: तस्मिन सुतुमुले युद्धे वर्तमाने जनक्षये॥ दुर्योधनश्च भीमश्च समेयातां महाबलौ॥
en: When that dreadful and destructive battle raged on the highly powerful Duryodhana and Bhima fought with each other.

sa: तस्मिन् हते भ्रातरि चित्रसेने क्रुद्धः कर्णः पौरुषः दर्शयानः। व्यद्रावयत् पाण्डवानामनीकं प्रत्युद्यातो नकुलनामितौजाः॥
en: Karna of unparalleled energy, seeing his brother Chitrasena dead, showed great prowess and began to disperse the Pandava troops but Nakula thereupon faced him.

sa: भीमसेनं च नवभिर्नकुलं पञ्चभिस्तथा। सहदेवं तथाष्टाभिः शतेन च शिखण्डिनम्॥
en: (And he pierced) Bhimasena with nine, Nakula with five, Sahadeva with eight and Shikhandi with one hundred arrows.

sa: रथौघाश्च हयौघाश्च नरौघाश्च समन्ततः। गजौघाश्च महाराज संसक्ताश्च परस्परम्॥
en: Cars, horses, men and elephants, O monarch, in large numbers, encountered one another on all sides.

sa: मन्त्रितं तव पुत्रस्य ते सर्वमवमेनिरे। येन मन्त्रेण निहताः शतशः क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥
en: All of them censured the policy of your son, in virtue of which hundreds of foremost of men were destroyed.

sa: सात्यकिः सप्तविंशत्या द्रौणि विद्ध्वा शिलीमुखैः। पुनर्विव्याध नाराचैः सप्तभिः स्वर्णभूषितैः॥
en: Piercing the son of Drona with twenty seven arrows he again pierced him with seven gold-plated winged arrows.

sa: कर्तव्यं नाभ्यजानान् वै कुमारा राजसत्तम। तान् विमूढान् रणे द्रोणः प्रहसन्निव भारत॥
en: Became embarrassed as to what they should do, O foremost of kings. Then when they were thus confounded, Drona with perfect ease.

sa: स विद्धो बहुभिः संख्ये प्रतिविव्याध तान् नृपान्। सौश्रुतिं सप्तभिरिद्ध्वा सत्यसेनं त्रिभिः शरै॥
en: He (Arjuna) been thus penetrated, in the battle by numerous heroes, pierced in return those kings-piercing Susruti with seven arrows and Satyasena, with three.

sa: तमुत्थाप्य ततो राजा परिष्वज्य च पीडितम्। मू[पाघ्राय चैवैनमिदं पुनरुवाच ह॥
en: The king them raising him clasped him to his bosom and smelling his head once more addressed him thus :

sa: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर। इष्टापूर्तेन च शपे वीर्येण च सुतैरपि॥
en: O the foremost of those that wield weapons, I promise truly and swear by my good acts, my prowess and my sons.

sa: पश्य कृष्ण महाबाहो संशप्तकगणान् बहून्। कुर्वाणान् दारुणं कर्म वध्यमानान् सहस्रशः॥
en: “Behold, O Krishna, O you of long arms, those numberless Samsaptakas, bent upon a dreadful feat, are killed by thousands.

sa: तत: क्रुद्धो महाराज माधवस्तस्य संयुगे। रथं सूतं ध्वजं तं च चक्रेऽदृश्यमजिह्मगैः॥
en: Rendered Dushasana's car, charioteer and standard invisible with his swift flying arrows. he then entirely shrouded the heroic Dushasana with his shafts.

sa: दुर्योधनेन समरे पृतना पाण्डवी रणे॥ नलिनी द्विरदेनेव समन्तात् प्रतिलोडिता।
en: Then the Pandava troops were completely crushed by Duryodhana like a forest of lotuses destroyed by an elephant.

sa: यस्मिन् दानं दमः शौचमहिंसा ही तिः क्षमा। अनपायानि सर्वाणि नित्यं राज्ञि युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: King Yudhishthira is always characterised by charity, self-restraint, purity, absence of cruelty, modesty, intelligence and forgiveness and all (the virtuous) that do not perish.

sa: मूढ चैनं समालोक्य सारथिस्त्वरितो रथम्। अपोवाह भृशं त्रस्तो वध्यमानः शितैः शरैः॥
en: Having seen him thus senseless and himself being deeply struck with sharp arrows, his charioteer with great rapidity carried away the car.

sa: शरणं त्वां महाराज प्रपन्नौ स्व उभावपि॥ क्षन्तुमर्हसि मे राजन् प्रणतस्याभियाचतः।
en: O king! we both of us surrender ourselves to you. I beseech you, by all means vouchsafe us your pardon.

sa: संजय उवाच प्रसाद्य धर्मराजानं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना. पार्थः प्रोवाच गोविन्दं सूतपुत्रवधोद्यतः॥
en: Sanjaya said On having satisfied Yudhishthira, Partha, bent upon slaying the son of Suta, cheerfully said unto Govinda:

sa: वसवो मरुतः साध्या रुद्रा विश्वेऽश्विनौ तथा॥ अग्निरिन्द्रश्च सोमश्च पवनोऽथ दिशो दश। धनंजयस्य ते पक्षे आदित्याः कर्णतोऽभवन्॥ विशः शूद्राश्च सूताश्च ये च संकर जायतः। सर्वशस्ते महाराज राधेयमभजस्तदा॥
en: The Vasus, the Maruts, the Siddhas, the Rudras, the Visvadevas, the Asvins, the Agni, the Soma Indra, the Pavana and the ten sides were in favor of Dhananjaya but the Aditya sided Karna. O monarch, the Vaisyas, the Sudras, the Sutas and other half caste people were in favour of Radha's son.

sa: प्रतिविव्याध तं राजन् नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः। पुनश्चैनं त्रिसप्तत्या भूयश्चैव शतेन तु॥
en: King (Virata also) pierced him in returm with nine sharpened arrows, again with seventy-three and once more with a hundred.

sa: ब्रह्मणा च प्रजाः सृष्टा गाण्डीवं च महद् धनुः॥ येनं त्वं युध्यसे पार्थ तस्मान्नास्ति त्वया समः।
en: Brahma, the creator of all beings, has himself made that powerful bow Gandiva, O Parthas, which you fight with. And that is why no one can outstrip you in battle.

sa: निशीथे तुरगा राजन् द्रावयन्तः परस्परम्। समदृश्यन्त वेगेन पक्षवन्तो यथाऽद्रयः॥
en: O king, at dead of night, horses, rushing furiously against one another, looked like mountains endued with wings.

sa: तथा तद्भवद् युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम्। लोहितोदा महानद्यः प्रसस्रुस्तत्र चासकृत्॥
en: Then there took place a dreadful encounter and there flew a river of blood striking terror unto all.

sa: यत्राभ्यगतच्छन् समरे पञ्चालाः कौरवैः सहा। ११॥ नरा नरैः समजाग्मुर्वारणा वरवारणैः। रथाश्च रथिभिः सार्धं हयाश्च हयसादिभिः॥
en: In that part of the battle, where the Panchalas encountered the Kaurava divisions, the inen came against the foremost of elephants. The car-warriors encountered the car-warriors and horsemen with horsemen.

sa: सत्यसेनश्चन्द्रदेवो मित्रदेवः सुतंजयः। सौश्रुतिश्चित्रसेनश्च मित्रवर्मा च भारत॥
en: Then Satyasena, Chandradeva, Mitradeva, Shrutanjaya, Sausruti, Chitrasena and Mitravarman, descendant of the Bharata race.

sa: एवं तं विरथं कृत्वा सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। जघान वृषसेनस्य त्रिसाहस्रान् महारथान्॥
en: Then Satyaki of infallible prowess, thus rendering Drona's son carless, slew the three thousand mighty car-warriors engaged in supporting Vrishasena.

sa: कङ्का गृध्रा बकाः श्येना वायसाश्च विशाम्पते॥ अग्रतस्तस्य गच्छन्ति मांसहेतोभयानकाः।
en: While O monarch, the portentous Kankas, vultures, cranes, hawks and revens flew before him in anticipation of food.

sa: प्रयातस्याथ पार्थस्य महान् स्वेदो व्यजायत।॥ चिन्ता च विपुला जज्ञे कथं चेदं भविष्यति।
en: While on his way to the field Partha began to perspire copiously and became deeply thoughtful as to how he would gain his end.

sa: शेषांश्च पाण्डवान् योधाः प्रसभं हीनतेजसः। सोऽयं मम जयो व्यक्तो दीर्घकालं भविष्यति।
en: The remaining Pandavas, destitute of energy, will be easily subjugated by (my) warriors. My success, then, will last for a long time.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं ततः कर्णो विव्याध दशभिः शरै। पञ्चभिट्टैणपुत्रस्तुं स्वयं द्रोणस्तु सप्तभिः॥
en: In that battle, cutting off arrows with his own close-knotted shafts, Karna then began to pierce Dhristadyumna with sharp arrows.

sa: ततः कर्णो महाराज प्रविवेश महद् भयम्॥ दृष्ट्वा भीमस्य विक्रान्तमन्तकस्य प्रजास्विव।
en: O monarch, as human beings are afraid of death, so Karna seeing Bhima of great power became afraid of him.

sa: ईहामृगा व्यालमृगा माङ्गल्याश्च मृगद्विजाः॥ पार्थस्य विजये सर्व एवाभिसंसृताः। राजन्
en: The wolves and deer of the wild and other animals and birds of good omen all sided Partha.

sa: ततः प्रासृजदुग्राणि शरवर्षाणि पाण्डवः। समरे तमनादृत्य तस्य वीर्यमचिन्तयन्॥
en: Thereat Pandu's son, disregarding the display of Karna's prowess began to shower fierce arrows on him.

sa: तं द्रौणिः समरे क्रुद्धं छादयामास पत्रिभिः। विव्याध चैनं दशभिः पितुर्वधमनुस्मरन्। ४१॥
en: Thereupon Drona's covered that enraged hero with innumerable winged shafts and remembering the slaughter of his sire, pierced him with ten shafts.

sa: भीमो वा सूतपुत्रेण स्मरन् वैरं पुरा कृतम्। अयुध्यत कथं शूरः कर्णेन सह संयुगे।॥
en: How did Bhima, that hero, fight with Suta's Karna, keeping alive the memory of the wrongs inflicted on him by the latter in days gone by?

sa: अयं तु सदृशः शौरेः शल्यः समितिशोभन:। सारथ्यं यदि मे कुर्याद् ध्रुवस्ते विजयो भवेत्॥
en: Indeed, this Shalya, who is the creator of the assemblies, resembles Shauri. Should be perform the duties of my charioteer, the victory will surely by yours.

sa: संधाय च चमू द्रोणो भोजे भारं निवेश्य स॥ अभ्यघावद् रणे यत्तो युयुधानं युयुत्सया।
en: Thereafter uniting his troops and vesting the ruler of the Bhojas' with their command, Drona with a firm resolve for fighting with Yuyudhana, rushed against him.

sa: उवाच सारथिं तत्र क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः। हार्दिक्याभिमुखं सूत कुरु मे रथमुत्तमम्॥
en: He filled with rage and fury said to the charioteer 0 Suta! Proceed my excellent chariot towards Hardikya.

sa: महाद्विपेनेव वने मत्तेन हरियूथपम्। इत्येवं भाषमाणे तु पाण्डवे वै धनंजये॥
en: Like a huge and infuriate elephant sporting in the woods with mighty lion.” While Pandu's son Dhananjaya was thus speaking.

sa: एवमुक्ते तु वचने सूतस्तस्य महामते। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात्॥
en: Having said these words ) intelligent one! He proceeded towards Kritavarman in a moment.

sa: करिष्यत: किञ्च नो भीमपार्थों तपन्तमेनं जहि पापं निशीथे। यो नः संग्रामाद् घोररूपाद् विमुच्येत् स नः पार्थान् सबलान् योधयेत॥
en: What can Bhima or Arjuna do to us? Slay this wicked Rakshasa, who is consuming us all, at this dead of night. They, that will escape alive form this encounter, will fight with the Parthas tomorrow.

sa: स पीडितो भृशं तेन धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥ उपविश्य रथोपस्थे सूतं याहीत्यचोदयत्।
en: Thus greatly assailed by him the pious king Yudhishthira sat down on his car and ordered his charioteer to go.

sa: कचिद् वीर्यं यथापूर्वं भुजयोर्वा बलं तव। कचित् ते गाण्डिवं हस्ते रथे तिष्ठसि चार्जुन॥
en: Have you the same strength of your arms as you had before? Do you still hold your Gandiva in hand? Are you seated in the warchariot?

sa: यदाप्रभृति कर्णाय शक्तिर्दत्ता महात्मना। वासवेन महाबाहो क्षिप्ता यासौ घटोत्कच॥ कुण्डलाभ्यां निमायाथ दिव्येन कवचेन च। तां प्राप्यामन्यत वृषः सततं त्वां हतं रणे॥
en: 0 mighty-armed one, since the time the illustrious Shakra gave that Sakti to Karna in exchange for the latter's earrings and armour-that Salkti, which has slain Ghatotkacha from that time, Vrisha having obtained it. had always regarded you as slain in battle.

sa: तोमरं व्यसृजत्तूर्णं सात्यकिं प्रति मारिष स निर्भिद्य भुजं सव्यं माधवस्य महारणे॥
en: Quickly hurled a Tomara at Satyaki O sire. That Tomora piercing through the left arm of the illustrious Madhava in that battle.

sa: कर्ण उवाच अद्य राजन् समेष्यामि पाण्डवेन यशस्विना। निहनिष्यामि तं वीरं स वा मां निहनिष्यति॥
en: Karna said Today, O monarch, I will go forth for battle with the famous son of Pandu. Either I shall slay that hero or he will slay me.

sa: तौ प्रयातौ पुनदृष्ट्वा तदान्ये सैनिकाब्रुवन्। त्वरध्वं कुरवः सर्वे वधे कृष्णकिरीटिनोः॥
en: Beholding them gone away, other soldiers said-"O Kurus, prepare yourselves in all haste for slaughtering Krishna and the diademdecked Arjuna.

sa: नाहमात्मनि कंचिद् वै किल्बिषं कर्ण संस्मरे। येन मां त्वं महाबाहो हन्तुमिच्छस्यनागसम्॥
en: O Karna, I do not remember a single sin in me for which you desire to kill me innocent as I am.

sa: स त्वन्यं रथमास्थाय विधिवत् कल्पित पुनः॥ युयुधे पाण्डुभिः सार्धं कर्णस्याप्याययन् बलम्।
en: Then riding on another car properly equipped once more he began to fight with the, Pandavas from within the division of Karna.

sa: ततः प्रासृजदुग्राणि शरवर्षाणि संघशः। तैर्विसृष्टैर्महाराज व्यद्रवत पाण्डवी चमूः॥
en: Then he began to shower sharp shafts on the armies of the Pandavas and rout them.

sa: येन ते सह योद्धव्यं स्थिरो भव धनंजय। पश्य चैन समायुक्त रथं कर्णस्य पाण्डव॥ श्वेतराजिसमायुक्तं युक्तं राधासुतेन त।
en: O Dhananjaya! With the intention of meeting you in battle so wait with calmness. O son of Pandu, look how beautifully the car of Karna is adorned; the son of Radha is on it.

sa: विस्मयो मे महान् पार्थ तव दृष्ट्वा शरानिमान्। व्यर्थान् निपतितान् संख्ये दुर्योधनरर्थ प्रति॥
en: Seeing all these shafts of yours falling upon Duryodhana's chariots without producing the least effect, o Partha, I have been filled with great surprise.

sa: कुन्तिभोजं ततो रक्षो विद्ध्वा बहुभिरायसैः। अनदद् भैरवं नादं वाहिन्याः प्रमुखे तव॥
en: Then that Rakshasa having pierce Kuntibhoja, with numerous swift, coursing arrows, uttered a terrible war-cry, standing in the van of your troops.

sa: नकुलं वृषसेनस्तु भित्वा पञ्चभिरायसैः। पितुः समीपे तिष्ठन् वै त्रिभिरन्यैरविध्यत॥
en: Standing by his father's side Vrishasena struck Nakula with five iron arrows and again wounded with three others.

sa: अपां पतिर्वेगवानप्रमेयो निमज्जयिष्यन् बहुलाः प्रजांश्च॥ महावेगं संकृरुते समुद्रो वेला चैनं धरायत्यप्रमेयम्।
en: The limitless deep, the king of waters dashes on impetuously for overwhelming numberless creatures. The continent flow over holds and restrains him.

sa: कथं हंस नु बलिनं चक्राङ्गं दूरपातिनम्। काको भूत्वा निपतने समाह्वयसि दुर्मते॥ कथं त्वं पतिता काक साहस्माभिब्रवीहि तत्।
en: A crow as you are, how do you, O fool, challenge a mighty swan coursing every where at will and traversing over a great distance. Tell us, Ocrow, how you will fly with us."

sa: व्यवस्थाप्य महाबाहुस्तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम्। प्रत्युद्ययौ तदा कर्णः पाण्डवान् युद्धदुर्मदान्॥ प्रत्युद्ययुस्तु राधेयं पाण्डवानां महारथाः। धुन्वानाः कार्मुकाण्याजौ विक्षिपन्तश्च सायकान्॥
en: Having collected your son's force the largearmed Karna advanced against the heroic Pandavas invincible in battle. Drawing their bows and discharging arrows the great carwarriors of the Pandavas advanced against the son of Radha.

sa: सत्यमुक्तं त्वया ब्रह्मन् पाण्डवान् प्रति यद् वचः॥४९ एते चान्ये च बहवो गुणाः पाण्डुसुतेषु वै।
en: “O Brahmana, the words that you have (just) spoken about the Pandavas are true. Indeed the sons of Pandu are gifted with these and many other noble qualities.

sa: दृष्ट्वा चैव महाराज द्रोणपुत्रपराक्रम्॥ निहतान् मेनिरे सर्वान् पाण्डून द्रोणसुतेन् वै।
en: O Maharaj, seeing the bravery of Drona's son made the people think, as if the Pandava army already were killed.

sa: स तत् कृत्वा राजपुत्रस्तरस्वी विव्याध भीमं नवभिः पृषत्कैः। ततोऽभिनद् बहुभिः क्षिप्रमेव वरेषुभिर्भीमसेन महात्मा।॥
en: That noble and energetic warrior after performing these brave acts, first distressed Bhima with nine shafts and almost iinmediately again covered him with numberless powerful shafts.

sa: त्वयि शस्राणि दिव्यानि त्र्यम्बके चामितौजसि। इच्छतो न हि ते मुच्येत् संक्रुद्धो हि पुरंदरः॥
en: Like the three-eyed Mahadeva of infinite energy, you possess all the celestial weapons; even the enraged Indra cannot escape you alive if you wish it not.

sa: जहि कृष्णौ महाबाहो धर्मराजं च मातुल। नकुलं सहदेवं च भीमसेनं तथैव च॥
en: O my uncle, slay me those fierce bowmen, the two Krishnas the very virtuous king Yudhishthira and Nakula and Sahadeva and Pandu's son Bhimasena.

sa: यथैव हि स कर्णेन पार्थः प्रच्छादितः शरैः। तथैव स रणे कर्ण छादयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: As Pritha's son himself had been covered by Suta's son, even in the same manner was the latter now covered by the former with his arrows.

sa: धूमकेतुरिव क्रुद्धः कथं मृत्युमुपेयिवान्॥ अव्यग्रानेव हि परान् कथयस्यपराजितान्।
en: Like a wrathful meteor, meet with his death? You always describe my enemies as cool, unvanquished.

sa: एतदत्र महाबाहो प्राप्तकालं मतं मम। एवं कृते कृतं चैव तव कार्यं भविष्यति॥
en: O mighty-aimed one, in my opinion this is the best course you could follow at present. By acting thus you will gain you ends."

sa: ततःक्रुद्धो महाराज द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। अर्जुनं वासुदेवं च छादयामास सायकैः॥
en: Thereupon filled with anger, O monarch, the highly powerful son of Drona covered Arjuna and Krishna with arrows.

sa: भारद्वाजस्ततो गत्वा धृष्टद्युम्नरथं प्रति। महद् युद्धं तदाऽऽसीत् तु द्रोणस्य निशि भारत। धृष्टद्युम्नेन वीरेण पञ्चालैश्च सहाद्भुतम्॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja also advancing against Dhristadyumna's car commenced at that night, O foremost of Bharatas, a most terrible and wonderful battle with the heroic Dhristadyumna and the Panchalas.

sa: के चैनं समरे वीरं प्रत्युद्ययुररिंदमाः॥ द्रोणं च के व्यरक्षन्त प्रविष्टे श्वेतवाहने।
en: What chastisers of foes opposed (the career of) that hero? Who were they that protected Drona when Shetavahana entered into our army)?

sa: न गोप्स्यति दुराचारः स आत्मानं कथंचन॥ तत्र छिद्रे प्रहर्तव्यं त्वयास्य कुरुसत्तम।
en: That wicked creature will no longer conceal himself. Taking advantage of that opportunity you should, O foremost of the Kurus, strike him.

sa: सोऽपक्रम्य मुहूर्त तु भीमसेनस्य गोचरात्। पुत्रांस्तव ददर्शाथ भीमसेनेन पातितान्॥
en: Retiring for a moment only from the presence of Bhimasena, Karna looked at your sons felled by him.

sa: स दिशः प्रादिशश्चैव च्छादयित्वा ह्यजिह्यगैः। वासुदेवं त्रिभिर्बाणैरविध्यद् दक्षिणे भुजे॥
en: Having filled all the quarters and directions with straight arrow he sundered Krishna's right arm with three arrows.

sa: नाशंसन्तो जयं युद्धे दीनात्मनो धनंजय। आत्मत्राणे मतिं कृत्वा प्राद्रवन् कुरवो रणात्॥
en: 0 Dhananjaya, the enemy depressed at heart, gave up all hopes of victory. They fled from the field, intent on saving themselves.

sa: दहन्तमहितान् सैन्ये नैनं कश्चिदवारयत्। यो यो हि प्रमुखे तस्य तस्थौ द्रोणस्य पुरुषः॥
en: Consume the evenings there was none among the arıny that could withstand him. Those persons who stood before Drona (in order to resist him).

sa: त्योः समीपं सम्प्राप्य पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ। न चकार भयं प्राप्ते भये महति मारिष॥
en: fear, Your son, O foremost of the Bharatas, approaching them entertained no although, O sire, there were reasons enough to fill him with terror.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आचार्ये निहते द्रोणे धृष्टद्युम्नेन संयुगे। निहते वज्रहस्तेन यथा वृत्रे महासुरे॥
en: Yudhishthira said Upon the slaughter of the preceptor Drona by Dhristadyumna like the slaughter of the mighly Asura Vrita by the wielder of thunderbolt.

sa: संजय उवाच क्षपितं पाण्डुपुत्रेण चेष्टतां नो विशाम्पते। तं तदाभिप्रशंसन्तमर्जुनं कुपितस्तदा॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon, your son, 0 king highly enraged, once more thus addressed Drona who had been praising Arjuna then.

sa: भीमसेनस्ततः कर्ण विहाय रथसत्तमम्। प्रयसौ कौरवं सैन्य कक्षमग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Then Bhimasena leaving Karna, the most powerful car-warrior, rushed towards the Kaurava force like a blazing forest fire.

sa: योत्स्याम्येनं शल्य धनंजयं वै मृत्युं पुरस्कृत्य रणे जयं वा॥ अन्यो हि न ह्येकरथेन मयों युध्येत यः पाण्डवमिन्द्रकल्पम्।
en: O Shalya, keeping either death or victory before me, I will fight with Dhananjaya today. There is none else but me who can fight on a single car with that Pandava resembling Death himself.

sa: स छिन्नधन्वा परिघं वज्रस्पर्शसमं युधि। आदाय चिक्षेप तदा द्रोणपुत्रः किरीटिने॥
en: Having his bow thus snapped Drona's son took up a sword, like unto a thunderbolt and hurled it at Arjuna.

sa: स शब्दस्तुमुल: खं द्यां पृथिवीं च व्यनादयत्। तं शब्दं पाण्डवाः श्रुत्वा पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्॥
en: That tremendous din resounded through the welkin. the heavens and the earth. Then hearing that sound that resembled the rumble of rain-clouds, the Pandavas.

sa: यथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मृत्योर्भीतानि मारिष। धर्ममेवोपलीयन्ते कर्मवन्ति हि यानि च॥ तथा कर्ण महेष्वास, पुत्रास्तव नराधिपः। उपालीयन्त संत्रासात् पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: O great king, your sons, being afraid of the noble son of Pandu, sought protection of the great warrior Karna, like the creature of the earth, responsible for their actions, take shelter of virtue from fear of death.

sa: कर्णचापच्युतान् बाणान् वर्जयंस्तु नरोत्तमः। अपयातस्तस्तूर्णं शिखण्डी भृशविक्षतः॥
en: Avoiding arrows shot off Karna's bow Shikhandi, greatly wounded, quickly retreated from the field.

sa: दृष्ट्वा विनिहतान् पुत्रांस्तव राजन् महारथान्। अश्रुपूर्णमुखः कर्णः क्षत्तुः सस्मार तद् वचः॥
en: Beholding your sons all mighty carwarriors slain, o king, Karna with a tearful countenance, began to think of those words of Khatva.

sa: ततो यौधिष्ठिरं सैन्यं वध्यमान महात्मना॥ सहसा प्राद्रवद राजन् सूतपुत्रशरार्दितम्।
en: Assailed with arrows by the great son of the charioteer Yudhishthira's soldiers all on a sudden fled away.

sa: शृगालोऽपि वने कर्ण शशैः परिवृतो वसन्। मन्यते सिंहमात्मानं यावत् सिंह न पश्यति॥
en: While living in the forest in the midst of hares a jackal, O Karna, considers himself a lion till he actually sees the latter.

sa: हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठन् पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते। मुमोच निशितान् बाणाशैनेयस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: O ruler of men, remaining in that steedless car, your son began to discharge sharp arrows towards the car of Shini's grandson.

sa: तत्तद् विकस्थमानानां भारं चोद्वहतां मृधे। यं भारं पुरुषो वोढं मनसा हि व्यवस्यति॥
en: Boasting in several ways of themselves who bear a (great) burden in war. That person, who resolves in his mind to bear a burden.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा द्रोणपुत्रस्य पर्यवर्तते वाहिनी। ततः सर्वे महाशङ्खान् दध्मुः पुरुषसत्तमाः॥
en: Hearing those words of Drona's son, the army rallied; all foremost of warriors therein blew their mighly conches.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततो राजन् ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्। द्रोणपुत्रं त्रिषष्ट्या तुराजन् विव्याध पत्रिणाम्॥
en: Thereupon, O king, Dhristadyumna pierced Drona's son looking like a blazing fire, with four and sixty winged arrows.

sa: स विसृष्टो बलवता शरो घोरो महामृधे। भासयामास तत् सैन्यं दिवाकर इवोदितः॥
en: In that terrible battle that shaft, shot by his strong arm, flooded the Kuru troops with its lustre like the risen sun.

sa: प्रतिविव्याध तं तूर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि मारिष। दशभिः सायकैर्हष्टस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: In return Dhristadyumna quickly pierced, in that battle, Karna, with five arrows and challenged him saying 'stay, stay.'

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच आपगेये हते शूरे दिव्यास्त्रवति संजय। द्रोणे च परमेष्वासे भृशं मे व्यथितं मनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, owing to the deaths of that heroic wielder of celestial weapons, the son of Ganga and the mighty bowman, Drona, my heart greatly aches.
